<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Chronicle — Visual Timeline Builder</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;0,900;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@300;400;500&family=Crimson+Pro:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;1,300;1,400&family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Josefin+Sans:wght@300;400;600&family=Libre+Baskerville:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=Lora:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --ink: #1a1208;
    --parchment: #f5f0e8;
    --aged: #e8dfc8;
    --rust: #b84c2e;
    --gold: #c9923a;
    --moss: #4a5e3a;
    --slate: #3d4a5c;
    --line: rgba(26,18,8,0.15);
    --shadow: rgba(26,18,8,0.2);
    --serif: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
    --mono: 'DM Mono', monospace;
    --body: 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: var(--body);
    min-height: 100vh;
    overflow-x: hidden;
  }

  /* ── LAYOUT ── */
  #app { display: flex; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; }

  /* ── SIDEBAR ── */
  #sidebar {
    width: 380px;
    min-width: 380px;
    background: var(--parchment);
    border-right: 2px solid var(--ink);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }
  #sidebar::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg, transparent, transparent 27px,
      rgba(26,18,8,0.06) 27px, rgba(26,18,8,0.06) 28px
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .sidebar-header {
    padding: 24px 24px 16px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--parchment);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .sidebar-header h1 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 28px;
    font-weight: 900;
    letter-spacing: -0.5px;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .sidebar-header p {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    opacity: 0.6;
    margin-top: 4px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }

  .sidebar-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--aged);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .tab-btn {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 10px 6px;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.5;
    border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  .tab-btn:last-child { border-right: none; }
  .tab-btn.active { opacity: 1; background: var(--parchment); font-weight: 500; }

  .tab-content { display: none; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 16px; }
  .tab-content.active { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px; }

  /* ── FORM ── */
  .form-section {
    background: white;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 16px;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--shadow);
  }
  .form-section h3 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .field { margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .field label {
    display: block;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0.6;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .field input, .field textarea, .field select {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 8px 10px;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: var(--body);
    font-size: 14px;
    background: var(--parchment);
    color: var(--ink);
    outline: none;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
    resize: vertical;
  }
  .field input:focus, .field textarea:focus, .field select:focus {
    border-color: var(--rust);
    background: white;
  }
  .field textarea { min-height: 70px; }
  .color-row { display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center; }
  .color-row input[type=color] {
    width: 40px; height: 34px; padding: 2px; cursor: pointer;
  }
  .img-preview {
    width: 100%; height: 80px;
    border: 1.5px dashed var(--line);
    border-radius: 2px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    opacity: 0.5;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }
  .img-preview img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; position: absolute; }
  .img-preview:hover { border-color: var(--rust); opacity: 1; }

  .btn {
    padding: 10px 16px;
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .btn:hover { background: var(--ink); color: var(--parchment); }
  .btn-primary {
    background: var(--rust);
    border-color: var(--rust);
    color: white;
  }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: #8f3920; border-color: #8f3920; }
  .btn-small { padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 10px; }
  .btn-row { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

  /* ── ENTRIES LIST ── */
  #entries-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
  .entry-item {
    background: white;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    cursor: grab;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 var(--shadow);
    transition: box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .entry-item:hover { box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--shadow); transform: translate(-1px,-1px); }
  .entry-item.dragging { opacity: 0.4; cursor: grabbing; }
  .entry-item.drag-over { border-color: var(--rust); border-style: dashed; }
  .drag-handle {
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.3;
    cursor: grab;
    font-size: 16px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .entry-dot {
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .entry-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .entry-year {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    opacity: 0.5;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }
  .entry-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .entry-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .icon-btn {
    width: 26px; height: 26px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: var(--parchment);
    cursor: pointer;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 12px;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .icon-btn:hover { background: var(--ink); color: white; border-color: var(--ink); }
  .icon-btn.del:hover { background: var(--rust); border-color: var(--rust); }

  /* ── SETTINGS TAB ── */
  .settings-group {
    background: white;
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 14px;
    box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 var(--shadow);
  }
  .settings-group h3 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    padding-bottom: 8px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .range-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
  .range-row input[type=range] { flex: 1; accent-color: var(--rust); }
  .range-val {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    width: 40px;
    text-align: right;
    opacity: 0.7;
  }

  /* ── MAIN CANVAS AREA ── */
  #main {
    flex: 1;
    background: #2a2418;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
  }
  #toolbar {
    background: var(--ink);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    padding: 10px 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  .toolbar-group { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  .toolbar-label {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.4);
  }
  .toolbar-btn {
    padding: 6px 12px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    border-radius: 2px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    color: var(--parchment);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .toolbar-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4); }
  .toolbar-btn.active { background: var(--rust); border-color: var(--rust); }
  .toolbar-sep { width: 1px; height: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }

  #canvas-wrap {
    flex: 1;
    overflow: auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 40px;
    background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #3d3428 0%, #1a1208 100%);
  }

  /* ── TIMELINE CANVAS ── */
  #timeline-canvas {
    background: var(--parchment);
    position: relative;
    transform-origin: top center;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #timeline-canvas::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(
      0deg, transparent, transparent 27px,
      rgba(26,18,8,0.04) 27px, rgba(26,18,8,0.04) 28px
    );
    pointer-events: none;
    z-index: 0;
  }

  .tl-header {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 60px 20px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .tl-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 900;
    color: var(--ink);
    line-height: 1.1;
  }
  .tl-subtitle {
    font-family: var(--body);
    font-style: italic;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.6;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }
  .tl-header-rule {
    width: 60px; height: 3px;
    background: var(--rust);
    margin: 16px auto 0;
  }

  /* ── THE TIMELINE SPINE ── */
  .tl-body {
    position: relative;
    padding: 20px 0 60px;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .tl-spine {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 0; bottom: 0;
    width: 2px;
    background: var(--ink);
    transform: translateX(-50%);
  }
  .tl-spine::before, .tl-spine::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
    background: var(--ink);
    border-radius: 50%;
  }
  .tl-spine::before { top: 0; }
  .tl-spine::after { bottom: 0; }

  /* ── TIMELINE ENTRIES ── */
  .tl-entry {
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    position: relative;
    min-height: 100px;
  }
  .tl-entry:nth-child(odd) { flex-direction: row; }
  .tl-entry:nth-child(even) { flex-direction: row-reverse; }

  .tl-entry-content {
    width: calc(50% - 40px);
    padding: 0 20px 30px;
  }
  .tl-entry:nth-child(odd) .tl-entry-content { text-align: right; padding-right: 30px; }
  .tl-entry:nth-child(even) .tl-entry-content { text-align: left; padding-left: 30px; }

  .tl-entry-node {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 8px;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .tl-node-dot {
    width: 16px; height: 16px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 3px solid var(--ink);
    background: var(--parchment);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--parchment);
  }

  .tl-entry-year {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    opacity: 0.5;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  .tl-entry-title {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--ink);
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .tl-entry-desc {
    font-family: var(--body);
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.75;
    line-height: 1.5;
  }
  .tl-entry-img {
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 120px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 2px;
    margin-top: 8px;
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
  .tl-entry-spacer { width: calc(50% - 40px); }

  /* single-column layout */
  #timeline-canvas.single-col .tl-spine { left: 40px; }
  #timeline-canvas.single-col .tl-entry { flex-direction: row !important; }
  #timeline-canvas.single-col .tl-entry-content { width: calc(100% - 80px); text-align: left !important; padding-left: 30px !important; padding-right: 20px !important; }
  #timeline-canvas.single-col .tl-entry-node { left: 40px; }
  #timeline-canvas.single-col .tl-entry-spacer { display: none; }

  /* ── MODAL ── */
  .modal-overlay {
    position: fixed; inset: 0;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    padding: 20px;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  }
  .modal-overlay.hidden { display: none; }
  .modal {
    background: var(--parchment);
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
    border-radius: 2px;
    box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink);
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 520px;
    max-height: 90vh;
    overflow-y: auto;
    position: relative;
  }
  .modal::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 27px, rgba(26,18,8,0.05) 27px, rgba(26,18,8,0.05) 28px);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .modal-header {
    padding: 20px 24px 16px;
    border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    background: var(--ink);
    color: var(--parchment);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .modal-header h2 {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-size: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
  }
  .modal-close {
    background: none; border: none;
    color: var(--parchment); font-size: 20px;
    cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.6;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
    font-family: var(--mono);
  }
  .modal-close:hover { opacity: 1; }
  .modal-body { padding: 20px 24px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .modal-footer {
    padding: 16px 24px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* ── VIDEO MODAL ── */
  #video-preview-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    background: black;
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  canvas#video-canvas { display: block; width: 100%; }
  .video-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }

  /* ── PRINT OVERLAY ── */
  #print-preview-wrap {
    width: 100%;
    background: #666;
    padding: 10px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    max-height: 400px;
    overflow-y: auto;
    border: 2px solid var(--ink);
  }
  .print-page {
    background: white;
    box-shadow: 2px 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .print-page-num {
    position: absolute;
    bottom: 4px;
    right: 8px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    opacity: 0.4;
  }
  .overlap-indicator {
    background: rgba(184,76,46,0.15);
    border: 1px dashed var(--rust);
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    color: var(--rust);
    letter-spacing: 1px;
  }

  /* ── EMPTY STATE ── */
  .empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    opacity: 0.35;
  }
  .empty-state .icon { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .empty-state p {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 16px;
  }

  /* ── SCROLLBAR ── */
  ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; height: 6px; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(26,18,8,0.25); border-radius: 3px; }

  /* ── STATUS BAR ── */
  #status-bar {
    background: var(--ink);
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.4);
    padding: 5px 20px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    gap: 20px;
    border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  }

  .tl-byline {
    font-family: var(--body);
    font-style: italic;
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.55;
    margin-top: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }
  .tl-footer {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 20px 60px 30px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0.35;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  /* ── MEDIA POPUP ── */
  .media-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 22px; height: 22px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1.5px solid currentColor;
    font-size: 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 6px;
    opacity: 0.7;
    transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 10;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .media-badge:hover { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1.1); }

  .media-popup {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 999;
    background: #1a1208;
    border: 2px solid #1a1208;
    border-radius: 4px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
    overflow: hidden;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.95) translateY(4px);
    transition: opacity 0.18s, transform 0.18s;
    width: 320px;
  }
  .media-popup.visible {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1) translateY(0);
    pointer-events: all;
  }
  .media-popup iframe {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 180px;
    border: none;
  }
  .media-popup img {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    max-height: 260px;
    object-fit: contain;
    background: #000;
  }
  .media-popup-label {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.5);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
  }
  .media-popup-close {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.5);
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    padding: 0;
    line-height: 1;
  }
  .media-popup-close:hover { color: white; }

  /* ── DYNAMIC THEME SUPPORT ── */
  #timeline-canvas.theme-dark .tl-title,
  #timeline-canvas.theme-dark .tl-subtitle,
  #timeline-canvas.theme-dark .tl-entry-year,
  #timeline-canvas.theme-dark .tl-entry-desc { color: rgba(245,240,232,0.85) !important; }
  #timeline-canvas.theme-dark { color: var(--parchment); }

  /* ── FILTER BAR ── */
  #filter-bar {
    background: var(--ink);
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    padding: 8px 20px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    min-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: max-height 0.3s;
  }
  #filter-bar.hidden { display: none; }
  .filter-label {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.4);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .filter-chip {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 5px;
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.75);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
    user-select: none;
  }
  .filter-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
  .filter-chip.active { background: var(--rust); border-color: var(--rust); color: white; }
  .filter-chip .chip-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }
  .filter-sep { width: 1px; height: 20px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); flex-shrink: 0; }
  .filter-importance-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 3px 8px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15);
    background: transparent;
    color: rgba(245,240,232,0.5);
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.15s;
  }
  .filter-importance-btn.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: rgba(245,240,232,0.9); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

  /* ── IMPORTANCE VISUALS ON TIMELINE ── */
  .tl-entry.imp-1 .tl-node-dot { width: 8px !important; height: 8px !important; opacity: 0.5; }
  .tl-entry.imp-2 .tl-node-dot { width: 10px !important; height: 10px !important; opacity: 0.7; }
  .tl-entry.imp-3 .tl-node-dot { width: 14px !important; height: 14px !important; }
  .tl-entry.imp-4 .tl-node-dot { width: 18px !important; height: 18px !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.08); }
  .tl-entry.imp-5 .tl-node-dot { width: 22px !important; height: 22px !important; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 0 0 7px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); }
  .tl-entry.imp-1 .tl-entry-title { opacity: 0.6; }
  .tl-entry.imp-4 .tl-entry-title { font-style: italic; }
  .tl-entry.imp-5 {
    position: relative;
  }
  .tl-entry.imp-5 .tl-entry-content::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: -8px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .imp-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 8px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0.45;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }

  /* ── ERA GROUPS ── */
  .tl-era-divider {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    padding: 24px 40px 12px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  .tl-era-label {
    font-family: var(--serif);
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    opacity: 0.35;
    white-space: nowrap;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .tl-era-line {
    flex: 1;
    height: 1px;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: 0.15;
  }

  /* ── IMAGE GALLERY & THUMBNAIL ── */
  .tl-img-gallery {
    display: flex;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 8px;
  }
  .tl-img-thumb {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 2px;
    border: 1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .tl-img-thumb:hover { transform: scale(1.08); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); }
  .tl-img-inline { width: 100%; max-height: 160px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 2px; margin-top: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); cursor: pointer; }
  .tl-img-hidden-badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    margin-top: 6px;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    opacity: 0.4;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed currentColor;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
  }
  .tl-img-hidden-badge:hover { opacity: 0.8; }
  .tl-img-hover-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; }
  .tl-img-hover-preview {
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 50;
    bottom: calc(100% + 8px);
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scale(0.95);
    width: 200px;
    border-radius: 3px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.15s, transform 0.15s;
  }
  .tl-img-hover-wrap:hover .tl-img-hover-preview {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(-50%) scale(1);
  }
  .tl-img-hover-preview img { width: 100%; display: block; }

  /* ── LIGHTBOX ── */
  #lightbox {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 9999;
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.2s;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
  }
  #lightbox.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: all; }
  #lightbox-img { max-width: 90vw; max-height: 80vh; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 2px; box-shadow: 0 20px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.8); }
  #lightbox-caption { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); font-family: var(--body); font-style: italic; font-size: 15px; text-align: center; }
  #lightbox-nav { display: flex; gap: 16px; }
  .lb-btn {
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    color: white;
    padding: 8px 20px;
    border-radius: 2px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }
  .lb-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
  #lightbox-close {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20px; right: 24px;
    color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    font-size: 28px;
    cursor: pointer;
    line-height: 1;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    transition: color 0.15s;
  }
  #lightbox-close:hover { color: white; }
  #lightbox-counter { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); letter-spacing: 2px; }

  /* ── SOURCE CITATION ── */
  .tl-entry-citation {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 9px;
    opacity: 0.3;
    margin-top: 4px;
    font-style: italic;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
  }

  /* ── BACKGROUND BUILDER ── */
  .bg-layer {
    background: var(--parchment);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 2px;
    padding: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .bg-layer-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .bg-layer-type {
    font-family: var(--mono);
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    font-weight: 600;
    opacity: 0.6;
    flex: 1;
  }
  .bg-layer-del {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 13px;
    opacity: 0.4;
    padding: 0;
    line-height: 1;
    transition: opacity 0.15s;
  }
  .bg-layer-del:hover { opacity: 1; color: var(--rust); }

  /* ── HORIZONTAL TIMELINE ── */
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: auto !important;
    min-width: max-content;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-header {
    padding: 30px 40px 20px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-body {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    align-items: stretch;
    padding: 0 60px 0;
    min-height: 420px;
    position: relative;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-spine {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0; right: 0;
    top: 50%;
    bottom: auto;
    width: 100%;
    height: 2px;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-spine::before {
    top: 50%; left: 0;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-spine::after {
    top: 50%; right: 0; left: auto;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    width: 10px; height: 10px;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column !important;
    align-items: center;
    position: relative;
    min-height: unset;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-above {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding-bottom: 28px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-below {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    padding-top: 28px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-node {
    position: relative;
    left: auto;
    top: auto;
    transform: none;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    z-index: 2;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-spacer { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-year { text-align: center; }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-title { text-align: center; }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-entry-desc { text-align: center; font-size: 11px !important; }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-era-divider {
    flex-direction: column;
    width: 20px;
    padding: 0;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-era-line {
    width: 1px;
    height: 40px;
    flex: unset;
  }
  #timeline-canvas.horizontal .tl-era-label {
    writing-mode: vertical-rl;
    text-orientation: mixed;
    transform: rotate(180deg);
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    font-size: 9px;
    margin: 4px 0;
  }

  /* ── CONNECTOR LINES ── */
  .tl-entry-connector {
    position: absolute;
    top: 16px; /* aligns with node center */
    z-index: 1;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* Left-side connector: runs from content edge rightward to spine */
  .tl-entry:nth-child(odd):not(.single-col-entry) .tl-entry-connector {
    right: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    justify-content: flex-end;
  }
  /* Right-side connector */
  .tl-entry:nth-child(even):not(.single-col-entry) .tl-entry-connector {
    left: 0;
  }
  .connector-h {
    /* horizontal leg — goes from content to near spine */
    height: 1.5px;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: 0.35;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .connector-v {
    /* vertical shared leg — runs along spine side, thickens with density */
    width: 2px;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: 0.55;
    border-radius: 1px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  /* Content box background clip — prevents line showing through text */
  .tl-entry-content {
    position: relative;
  }
  .tl-entry-content::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: inherit;
    z-index: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .tl-entry-content > * {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }

  /* ── COMPACT MODE ── */
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-entry-desc { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-entry-citation { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-img-inline { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-img-gallery { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-img-hover-wrap { display: none; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-entry-title { font-size: 13px !important; margin-bottom: 2px; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .tl-entry-year { font-size: 10px !important; margin-bottom: 1px; }
  #timeline-canvas.compact .imp-badge { display: none; }

  /* ── PROPORTIONAL SPACING — entries are absolutely positioned ── */
  #timeline-canvas .tl-body.proportional {
    padding: 0 0 60px;
  }
  #timeline-canvas .tl-body.proportional .tl-entry {
    position: absolute;
    width: 100%;
  }

  /* ── SORT HIGHLIGHT ── */
  .sort-btn.active-sort { background: var(--rust) !important; border-color: var(--rust) !important; }

  @media print {
    body * { visibility: hidden; }
    #print-content, #print-content * { visibility: visible; }
    #print-content { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; }
  }
</style>

<body>
<div id="app">

  <!-- ══ SIDEBAR ══ -->
  <div id="sidebar">
    <div class="sidebar-header">
      <h1>Chronicle</h1>
      <p>Visual Timeline Builder</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sidebar-tabs">
      <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="switchTab('add')">+ Add</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('entries')">Entries</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('connect')">⇄ Connect</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="switchTab('settings')">Style</button>
    </div>

    <!-- ADD TAB -->
    <div id="tab-add" class="tab-content active">
      <div class="form-section">
        <h3>New Entry</h3>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Title *</label>
          <input type="text" id="f-title" placeholder="Event title…" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Year / Date</label>
          <input type="text" id="f-year" placeholder="e.g. 1969, Aug 2001, BCE 44…" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Sort Key <span style="opacity:0.5;font-size:9px">(auto-detected from year, or enter manually)</span></label>
          <input type="number" id="f-sort" placeholder="Leave blank to auto-detect" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Description</label>
          <textarea id="f-desc" placeholder="Brief description of this event…"></textarea>
        </div>
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px">
          <div class="field" style="margin:0">
            <label>Category</label>
            <input type="text" id="f-category" placeholder="e.g. Church" list="category-suggestions" />
            <datalist id="category-suggestions"></datalist>
          </div>
          <div class="field" style="margin:0">
            <label>Importance</label>
            <select id="f-importance" onchange="applyImportanceColor(this.value)" style="font-weight:600">
              <option value="1" style="color:#999999">★ Blip</option>
              <option value="2" style="color:#7a9e7a">★★ Moment</option>
              <option value="3" selected style="color:#b84c2e">★★★ Event</option>
              <option value="4" style="color:#c9923a">★★★★ Milestone</option>
              <option value="5" style="color:#7c3aed">★★★★★ Landmark</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field" style="margin-top:8px">
          <label>Accent Color</label>
          <div class="color-row">
            <input type="color" id="f-color" value="#b84c2e" />
            <span style="font-size:12px;opacity:0.6;font-family:var(--mono)">Node & highlight color</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Location <span style="opacity:0.4;font-size:9px">(optional)</span></label>
          <input type="text" id="f-location" placeholder="e.g. 123 Main St, Pleasanton" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Source / Citation <span style="opacity:0.4;font-size:9px">(shown as footnote)</span></label>
          <input type="text" id="f-citation" placeholder="e.g. Church archives, 1923" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Images <span style="opacity:0.4;font-size:9px">(multiple OK — click or drop)</span></label>
          <div class="img-preview" id="img-drop-zone" onclick="document.getElementById('f-img').click()" style="height:64px">
            <span id="img-drop-label">Click or drop images</span>
            <div id="img-thumbs-row" style="display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;padding:6px;gap:4px;overflow-x:auto;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:center"></div>
          </div>
          <input type="file" id="f-img" accept="image/*" multiple style="display:none" onchange="handleImgSelect(event)" />
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Image Display Mode</label>
          <select id="f-img-display">
            <option value="inline">Inline — shown below text</option>
            <option value="thumbnail">Thumbnail — small square, click to enlarge</option>
            <option value="hover">Hidden — icon only, hover to preview</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Media URL <span style="opacity:0.5;font-size:9px">(YouTube, Vimeo, or image URL)</span></label>
          <input type="text" id="f-media" placeholder="https://youtube.com/watch?v=… or image URL" />
          <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;opacity:0.4;margin-top:3px">Hover popup on timeline — YouTube UI is stripped</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btn-row" style="margin-top:4px">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="addEntry()" style="flex:1">Add to Timeline</button>
          <button class="btn" onclick="clearForm()">Clear</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ENTRIES TAB -->
    <div id="tab-entries" class="tab-content">
      <div class="btn-row">
        <button class="btn btn-small sort-btn" id="sort-asc" onclick="sortEntries('asc')">▲ Year</button>
        <button class="btn btn-small sort-btn" id="sort-desc" onclick="sortEntries('desc')">▼ Year</button>
        <button class="btn btn-small sort-btn" id="sort-added" onclick="sortEntries('added')">Added</button>
        <button class="btn btn-small" onclick="sortEntries('manual')" style="opacity:0.5">Manual</button>
      </div>
      <div id="entries-list"></div>
    </div>

    <!-- CONNECT TAB -->
    <div id="tab-connect" class="tab-content">

      <!-- FILE PROTOCOL WARNING -->
      <div id="file-protocol-warning" style="display:none;background:#8f3920;color:white;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:2px;margin-bottom:12px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:0.5px;line-height:1.6">
        ⚠ <strong>Google Sheets won't connect</strong> when the app is opened as a local file.<br>
        Open via Live Server, Python server, or GitHub Pages instead.
        <a href="#" onclick="alert('Option 1: VS Code → install Live Server extension → right-click file → Open with Live Server\n\nOption 2: Terminal → cd ~/Downloads → python3 -m http.server 8000 → open http://localhost:8000/timeline-builder.html\n\nOption 3: Upload to GitHub Pages');return false" style="color:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);display:block;margin-top:4px">How to fix this →</a>
      </div>

      <!-- CONNECTION STATUS -->
      <div class="form-section">
        <h3>Google Sheet</h3>
        <div id="connect-status-bar" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;padding:8px 10px;background:var(--aged);border-radius:2px;border:1px solid var(--line)">
          <span id="connect-status-dot" style="width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#999;flex-shrink:0"></span>
          <span id="connect-status-text" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px">NOT CONNECTED</span>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Google Sheet URL</label>
          <textarea id="c-sheet-url" placeholder="Paste your Google Sheet URL here…" style="min-height:56px;font-size:11px;word-break:break-all"></textarea>
          <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;opacity:0.45;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.5">
            In your sheet: File → Share → Publish to web → select sheet tab → CSV → Publish. Then paste the full sheet URL (not the publish URL — the regular URL from your browser).
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>Timeline Tab</label>
          <select id="c-tab-name" style="font-size:12px">
            <option value="">— connect first —</option>
          </select>
          <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;opacity:0.45;margin-top:3px">Which sheet tab to read from</div>
        </div>
        <div class="btn-row">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="connectToSheet()" style="flex:1">⇄ Connect & Load</button>
          <button class="btn btn-small" onclick="refreshFromSheet()" title="Reload entries from sheet">↺</button>
        </div>
        <div id="c-last-sync" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;opacity:0.4;margin-top:6px;text-align:center"></div>
      </div>

      <!-- COLUMN MAPPING -->
      <div class="form-section" id="c-mapping-section" style="display:none">
        <h3>Column Mapping</h3>
        <div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;opacity:0.5;margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.5">Defaults match the Chronicle setup script exactly (A–K). Only change these if your sheet uses a different order.</div>
        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px">
          <div class="field" style="margin:0"><label>Title</label><input type="text" id="cm-title" value="A" style="font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase" maxlength="2" /></div>
          <div class="field" style="margin:0"><label>Year / Date</label><input type="text" id="cm-year" value="B" style="font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase" maxlength="2" /></div>
          <div class="field" style="margin:0"><label>Sort Key</label><input type="text" id="cm-sort" value="C" style="font-size:13px;text-transform:uppercase" maxlength="2" /></div>

// ══════════════════════════════════════════

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function switchTab(name) {
  const tabNames = ['add','entries','connect','settings'];
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach((b,i) => b.classList.toggle('active', tabNames[i] === name));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// ADD ENTRY
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function parseSortKeyFromYear(yearStr) {
  // Returns a numeric sort key parsed from the year text, or null if unparseable
  if (!yearStr) return null;
  const s = yearStr.replace(/,/g,'').trim();
  const bce = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*(bce|bc|b\.c\.?e?\.?)/i);
  if (bce) return -Math.abs(parseFloat(bce[1]));
  const bya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*bya/i);
  if (bya) return -parseFloat(bya[1]) * 1e9;
  const mya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*mya/i);
  if (mya) return -parseFloat(mya[1]) * 1e6;
  const kya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*kya/i);
  if (kya) return -parseFloat(kya[1]) * 1e3;
  const plain = s.match(/^-?\d+\.?\d*/);
  if (plain) return parseFloat(plain[0]);
  return null;
}

function guessSortKey(yearStr, explicitSort) {
  // If user typed a number in the Sort Key field, use it
  const explicit = document.getElementById(explicitSort || 'f-sort').value.trim();
  if (explicit !== '') return { key: parseFloat(explicit), guessed: false };
  // Otherwise try to parse the year display field
  const parsed = parseSortKeyFromYear(yearStr);
  if (parsed !== null) return { key: parsed, guessed: false };
  // Unparseable/blank year — inherit from the most recently added entry rather than
  // injecting a fake value like 0 or an entry count, which would corrupt time-proportional spacing
  return { key: entries.length ? entries[entries.length - 1].sortKey : 0, guessed: true };
}

function addEntry() {
  const title = document.getElementById('f-title').value.trim();
  if (!title) { document.getElementById('f-title').focus(); return; }
  const yearVal = document.getElementById('f-year').value.trim();
  const sortResult = guessSortKey(yearVal, 'f-sort');
  const entry = {
    id: nextId++,
    title,
    year: yearVal,
    sortKey: sortResult.key,
    sortKeyGuessed: sortResult.guessed,
    desc: document.getElementById('f-desc').value.trim(),
    color: document.getElementById('f-color').value,
    category: document.getElementById('f-category').value.trim(),
    importance: parseInt(document.getElementById('f-importance').value) || 3,
    location: document.getElementById('f-location').value.trim(),
    citation: document.getElementById('f-citation').value.trim(),
    images: [...currentImages],
    img: currentImages[0] || null,  // backward compat
    imageDisplay: document.getElementById('f-img-display').value,
    mediaUrl: document.getElementById('f-media').value.trim(),
    addedOrder: entries.length,
    source: 'manual'
  };
  entries.push(entry);
  clearForm();
  rebuildCategoryFilters();
  renderAll();
  switchTab('entries');
}

function clearForm() {
  ['f-title','f-year','f-sort','f-desc','f-media','f-category','f-location','f-citation'].forEach(id => {
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el) el.value = '';
  });
  document.getElementById('f-color').value = '#b84c2e';
  document.getElementById('f-importance').value = '3';
  document.getElementById('f-img-display').value = 'inline';
  currentImages = [];
  const thumbsRow = document.getElementById('img-thumbs-row');
  if (thumbsRow) { thumbsRow.innerHTML = ''; thumbsRow.style.display = 'none'; }
  const label = document.getElementById('img-drop-label');
  if (label) label.style.display = '';
}

function handleImgSelect(e) {
  const files = Array.from(e.target.files);
  if (!files.length) return;
  files.forEach(file => {
    if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
      currentImages.push(ev.target.result);
      updateImgThumbsRow();
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function updateImgThumbsRow() {
  const thumbsRow = document.getElementById('img-thumbs-row');
  const label = document.getElementById('img-drop-label');
  if (!thumbsRow) return;
  if (!currentImages.length) {
    thumbsRow.style.display = 'none';
    thumbsRow.innerHTML = '';
    if (label) label.style.display = '';
    return;
  }
  if (label) label.style.display = 'none';
  thumbsRow.style.display = 'flex';
  thumbsRow.innerHTML = currentImages.map((src, i) => `
    <div style="position:relative;flex-shrink:0">
      <img src="${src}" style="width:44px;height:44px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:2px;border:1.5px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15)" />
      <button onclick="removeFormImg(${i})" style="position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--rust);border:none;color:white;font-size:8px;cursor:pointer;line-height:14px;text-align:center;padding:0">✕</button>
    </div>
  `).join('') + `<div style="flex-shrink:0;width:36px;height:36px;border:1.5px dashed rgba(0,0,0,0.2);border-radius:2px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;color:rgba(0,0,0,0.3)" onclick="document.getElementById('f-img').click()">+</div>`;
}

function removeFormImg(idx) {
  currentImages.splice(idx, 1);
  updateImgThumbsRow();
}

// Drag & drop image
const dropZone = document.getElementById('img-drop-zone');
dropZone.addEventListener('dragover', e => { e.preventDefault(); dropZone.style.borderColor = 'var(--rust)'; });
dropZone.addEventListener('dragleave', () => dropZone.style.borderColor = '');
dropZone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  dropZone.style.borderColor = '';
  const files = Array.from(e.dataTransfer.files).filter(f => f.type.startsWith('image/'));
  files.forEach(file => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
      currentImages.push(ev.target.result);
      updateImgThumbsRow();
    };
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
});

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// SORT
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function sortEntries(mode) {
  currentSort = mode;
  document.querySelectorAll('.sort-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active-sort'));
  const btnMap = {asc:'sort-asc',desc:'sort-desc',added:'sort-added'};
  if (btnMap[mode]) document.getElementById(btnMap[mode]).classList.add('active-sort');

  if (mode === 'asc') entries.sort((a,b) => a.sortKey - b.sortKey);
  else if (mode === 'desc') entries.sort((a,b) => b.sortKey - a.sortKey);
  else if (mode === 'added') entries.sort((a,b) => a.addedOrder - b.addedOrder);
  renderAll();
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// RENDER ENTRIES LIST (sidebar)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function renderEntriesList() {
  const el = document.getElementById('entries-list');

  el.innerHTML = entries.map((e,i) => `
    <div class="entry-item" draggable="true" data-idx="${i}"

      ondragover="dragOver(event,${i})"

        <button class="icon-btn del" onclick="deleteEntry(${e.id})" title="Delete">✕</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  `).join('');
}

// ══════════════════════════════════════════
// DRAG & DROP (manual reorder)
// ══════════════════════════════════════════
function dragStart(e, idx) { dragSrcIdx = idx; e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging'); }
function dragOver(e, idx) {
  e.preventDefault();
  document.querySelectorAll('.entry-item').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drag-over'));
  if (idx !== dragSrcIdx) e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');
}
function drop(e, idx) {
  e.preventDefault();
  if (dragSrcIdx === null || dragSrcIdx === idx) return;
  const moved = entries.splice(dragSrcIdx, 1)[0];
  entries.splice(idx, 0, moved);
  entries.forEach((en, i) => en.addedOrder = i);
  renderAll();
}
function dragEnd() {
  dragSrcIdx = null;
  document.querySelectorAll('.entry-item').forEach(el => { el.classList.remove('dragging','drag-over'); });
}

function buildBackgroundCSS() {
  // Build layered background CSS
  const layers = [];
  const imgs = [];

  // Texture on top
  if (settings.textureUrl) {
    layers.push(`rgba(0,0,0,0) url('${settings.textureUrl}') repeat`);
    // We handle opacity separately via pseudo-element — for now just add the layer
  }

  // Color wash over image
  if (settings.washOn) {
    const rgb = hexToRgb(settings.washColor);
    layers.push(`rgba(${rgb},${settings.washOpacity})`);
  }

  // Main image
  if (settings.bgimg) {
    layers.push(`url('${settings.bgimg}') ${settings.bgimgRepeat || 'no-repeat'} center / ${settings.bgimgSize || 'cover'}`);
  }

  // Gradient
  if (settings.gradientOn) {
    const fromC = settings.gradFrom, toC = settings.gradTo;
    const dir = settings.gradDir;
    let grad;
    if (dir === 'radial') {
      grad = `radial-gradient(ellipse at center, ${fromC}, ${toC})`;
    } else {
      grad = `linear-gradient(${dir}, ${fromC}, ${toC})`;
    }
    layers.push(grad);
  }

  // Base color always last (bottom)
  layers.push(settings.bg);

  return layers.join(', ');
}

function parseEras() {
  if (!settings.eras || !settings.showEras) return [];
  return settings.eras.split('\n').map(line => {
    const parts = line.split(',');
    if (parts.length < 2) return null;
    const year = parseFloat(parts[0].trim());
    const label = parts.slice(1).join(',').trim();
    if (isNaN(year) || !label) return null;
    return { year, label };
  }).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b) => a.year - b.year);
}

function renderTimeline() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('timeline-canvas');
  const container = document.getElementById('tl-entries-container');
  const titleEl = document.getElementById('tl-title-el');
  const subtitleEl = document.getElementById('tl-subtitle-el');
  const spineEl = canvas.querySelector('.tl-spine');

  const displayFont = settings.overrideFonts ? settings.fontDisplay : "'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif";
  const bodyFont = settings.overrideFonts ? settings.fontBody : "'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif";

  titleEl.textContent = settings.title;
  titleEl.style.fontSize = settings.titleSize + 'px';
  titleEl.style.fontFamily = displayFont;
  subtitleEl.textContent = settings.subtitle;
  subtitleEl.style.fontSize = (settings.titleSize * 0.4) + 'px';
  subtitleEl.style.fontFamily = bodyFont;

  canvas.style.width = settings.width + 'px';

  // Apply layered background
  const bgCSS = buildBackgroundCSS();
  canvas.style.background = bgCSS;

  // Texture overlay (separate pseudo-like element or direct style)
  // We'll handle texture opacity by setting a canvas child overlay if texture is set
  let textureOverlay = canvas.querySelector('.tl-texture-overlay');
  if (settings.textureUrl) {
    if (!textureOverlay) {
      textureOverlay = document.createElement('div');
      textureOverlay.className = 'tl-texture-overlay';
      textureOverlay.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0';
      canvas.insertBefore(textureOverlay, canvas.firstChild);
    }
    textureOverlay.style.backgroundImage = `url('${settings.textureUrl}')`;
    textureOverlay.style.backgroundRepeat = 'repeat';
    textureOverlay.style.opacity = settings.textureOpacity;
  } else if (textureOverlay) {
    textureOverlay.remove();
  }

  canvas.classList.toggle('single-col', settings.layout === 'single' && settings.orientation === 'vertical');
  canvas.classList.toggle('horizontal', settings.orientation === 'horizontal');
  canvas.classList.toggle('compact', settings.compactMode);

  // Dark theme detection
  const bgRgb = hexToRgb(settings.bg).split(',').map(Number);
  const brightness = (bgRgb[0] * 299 + bgRgb[1] * 587 + bgRgb[2] * 114) / 1000;
  canvas.classList.toggle('theme-dark', brightness < 128);

  if (spineEl) spineEl.style.background = settings.spineColor;
  canvas.style.setProperty('--spine-color', settings.spineColor);

  // Update preview swatch
  const swatch = document.getElementById('bg-preview-swatch');
  if (swatch) swatch.style.background = bgCSS;

  const visibleEntries = getVisibleEntries();
  const eras = parseEras();
  const importanceLabels = ['','Blip','Moment','Event','Milestone','Landmark'];

  if (!visibleEntries.length) {
    container.innerHTML = entries.length
      ? '<div class="empty-state"><div class="icon">🔍</div><p>No entries match the current filters</p></div>'
      : '<div class="empty-state"><div class="icon">📜</div><p>Add your first event to begin the chronicle…</p></div>';
    if (settings.orientation === 'horizontal') {
      document.getElementById('tl-body').style.cssText = '';
    }
    return;
  }

  // ── PROPORTIONAL SPACING MATH ──
  let positionMap = null; // entry id → position (px from top or left)
  if (settings.spacingMode === 'proportional' && visibleEntries.length > 1) {
    const sortKeys = visibleEntries.map(e => e.sortKey);
    const minKey = Math.min(...sortKeys);
    const maxKey = Math.max(...sortKeys);
    const span = maxKey - minKey || 1;
    const minGap = settings.minGap || 40;

    // First pass: ideal proportional positions
    const totalSize = Math.max(600, visibleEntries.length * minGap * 2);
    let positions = visibleEntries.map(e => ((e.sortKey - minKey) / span) * totalSize);

    // Second pass: enforce minimum gap
    for (let i = 1; i < positions.length; i++) {
      if (positions[i] - positions[i-1] < minGap) {
        positions[i] = positions[i-1] + minGap;
      }
    }

    // Add header offset
    const headerOffset = 120;
    positions = positions.map(p => p + headerOffset);
    const totalCanvas = positions[positions.length - 1] + 120;

    positionMap = {};
    visibleEntries.forEach((e, i) => { positionMap[e.id] = { pos: positions[i], total: totalCanvas }; });
  }

  // ── BUILD HTML ──
  if (settings.orientation === 'horizontal') {
    renderHorizontalTimeline(container, visibleEntries, eras, importanceLabels, displayFont, bodyFont);
  } else {
    renderVerticalTimeline(container, visibleEntries, eras, importanceLabels, displayFont, bodyFont, positionMap);
  }
}

  `};
}

// ── YEAR GROUPING FOR CONNECTOR THICKNESS ──
function buildYearGroups(visibleEntries) {
  const groups = new Map();
  visibleEntries.forEach(e => {
    const key = Math.round(e.sortKey);
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(e);
  });
  const groupSize = new Map();
  const groupIndex = new Map();
  groups.forEach(members => {
    members.forEach((e, i) => {
      groupSize.set(e.id, members.length);
      groupIndex.set(e.id, i);
    });
  });
  return { groupSize, groupIndex };
}

function connectorThickness(count) {
  return Math.min(6.5, 1.5 + (count - 1) * 1.2);
}

// Draws a properly-sized "density bar" on the spine for each group of same-year
// entries, AFTER the DOM has laid out real content — this avoids guessing pixel
// distances between entries (which vary with content height, spacing mode, etc.)
// and instead measures actual node positions to span the bar correctly.
function drawYearGroupBars(visibleEntries, isSingle, isHorizontal) {
  const body = document.getElementById('tl-body');
  if (!body) return;
  body.querySelectorAll('.year-group-bar').forEach(el => el.remove());

  const groups = new Map();
  visibleEntries.forEach(e => {
    const key = Math.round(e.sortKey);
    if (!groups.has(key)) groups.set(key, []);
    groups.get(key).push(e);
  });

  const bodyRect = body.getBoundingClientRect();

  groups.forEach(members => {
    if (members.length < 2) return;
    const thick = connectorThickness(members.length);
    const color = members[0].color || '#1a1208';
    let minPos = Infinity, maxPos = -Infinity;

    members.forEach(e => {
      const nodeEl = body.querySelector(`.tl-entry[data-id="${e.id}"] .tl-node-dot`);
      if (!nodeEl) return;
      const r = nodeEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = isHorizontal
        ? (r.left - bodyRect.left + r.width / 2)
        : (r.top - bodyRect.top + r.height / 2);
      minPos = Math.min(minPos, center);
      maxPos = Math.max(maxPos, center);
    });
    if (minPos === Infinity || maxPos - minPos < 1) return;

    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'year-group-bar';
    if (isHorizontal) {
      bar.style.cssText = `position:absolute;left:${minPos}px;width:${maxPos - minPos}px;height:${thick}px;top:calc(50% - ${thick/2}px);background:${color};opacity:0.4;border-radius:${thick/2}px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none`;
    } else {
      const leftPos = isSingle ? '40px' : '50%';
      const transform = isSingle ? '' : 'transform:translateX(-50%)';
      bar.style.cssText = `position:absolute;top:${minPos}px;height:${maxPos - minPos}px;width:${thick}px;left:${leftPos};${transform};background:${color};opacity:0.4;border-radius:${thick/2}px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none`;
    }
    body.appendChild(bar);
  });
}

// ── VERTICAL TIMELINE RENDERER ──
function renderVerticalTimeline(container, visibleEntries, eras, importanceLabels, displayFont, bodyFont, positionMap) {
  const body = document.getElementById('tl-body');
  const isSingle = settings.layout === 'single';
  const bgColor = settings.bg || '#f5f0e8';
  let html = '';
  let lastEraInserted = -1;

  const { groupSize, groupIndex } = buildYearGroups(visibleEntries);

  function makeConnector(e, color, isLeft) {
    // Draws only this entry's own horizontal leg from its content to near the spine.
    // Thickness reflects how many entries share this entry's year — the shared
    // vertical "density bar" connecting grouped entries is drawn separately in a
    // post-render pass (drawYearGroupBars) once real positions are known.
    const count = groupSize.get(e.id) || 1;
    const thick = connectorThickness(count);
    const hLen = 22;
    const borderR = isLeft ? '1px 0 0 1px' : '0 1px 1px 0';
    const side = isLeft ? 'right:calc(50% - 38px)' : 'left:calc(50% - 38px)';
    return `<div style="position:absolute;${side};top:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:1">
      <div style="height:${thick * 0.55}px;width:${hLen}px;background:${color};opacity:0.38;border-radius:${borderR}"></div>
    </div>`;
  }

  function makeSingleColConnector(e, color) {
    const count = groupSize.get(e.id) || 1;
    const thick = connectorThickness(count);
    return `<div style="position:absolute;left:40px;top:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:1">
      <div style="height:${thick * 0.55}px;width:22px;background:${color};opacity:0.38;border-radius:0 1px 1px 0"></div>
    </div>`;
  }

  if (positionMap) {
    const lastEntry = visibleEntries[visibleEntries.length - 1];
    body.style.height = positionMap[lastEntry.id].total + 'px';
    body.classList.add('proportional');

    visibleEntries.forEach((e, i) => {
      const { color, imp, contentHtml } = buildEntryContentHtml(e, displayFont, bodyFont);
      const pos = positionMap[e.id].pos;
      const isLeft = isSingle ? false : (i % 2 === 0);
      const connector = isSingle ? makeSingleColConnector(e, color) : makeConnector(e, color, isLeft);

      if (eras.length && settings.showEras) {
        eras.forEach((era, ei) => {
          if (ei > lastEraInserted && e.sortKey >= era.year) {
            html += `<div class="tl-era-divider" style="position:absolute;top:${pos - 30}px;left:0;right:0;z-index:1">
              <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
              <div class="tl-era-label" style="font-family:${displayFont}">${era.label}</div>
              <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
            </div>`;
            lastEraInserted = ei;
          }
        });
      }

      html += `<div class="tl-entry imp-${imp}" style="position:absolute;top:${pos}px;width:100%" data-id="${e.id}">
        ${isSingle ? '' : `<div class="tl-entry-spacer"></div>`}
        <div class="tl-entry-node" ${isSingle ? 'style="left:40px"' : ''}>
          <div class="tl-node-dot" style="border-color:${color};background:${color}"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-entry-content" style="background:${bgColor}">
          ${contentHtml}
        </div>
        ${connector}
      </div>`;
    });

  } else {
    body.style.height = '';
    body.classList.remove('proportional');

    visibleEntries.forEach((e, i) => {
      const { color, imp, contentHtml } = buildEntryContentHtml(e, displayFont, bodyFont);
      const pb = settings.spacing + 20;
      const isLeft = isSingle ? false : (i % 2 === 0);
      const connector = isSingle ? makeSingleColConnector(e, color) : makeConnector(e, color, isLeft);

      if (eras.length && settings.showEras) {
        eras.forEach((era, ei) => {
          if (ei > lastEraInserted && e.sortKey >= era.year) {
            html += `<div class="tl-era-divider" style="z-index:1;position:relative">
              <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
              <div class="tl-era-label" style="font-family:${displayFont}">${era.label}</div>
              <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
            </div>`;
            lastEraInserted = ei;
          }
        });
      }

      html += `<div class="tl-entry imp-${imp}" style="padding-bottom:${pb}px;position:relative" data-id="${e.id}">
        ${isSingle ? '' : `<div class="tl-entry-spacer"></div>`}
        <div class="tl-entry-node">
          <div class="tl-node-dot" style="border-color:${color};background:${color}"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tl-entry-content" style="background:${bgColor}">
          ${contentHtml}
        </div>
        ${connector}
      </div>`;
    });
  }

  container.innerHTML = html;
  drawYearGroupBars(visibleEntries, isSingle, false);
}

// ── HORIZONTAL TIMELINE RENDERER ──
function renderHorizontalTimeline(container, visibleEntries, eras, importanceLabels, displayFont, bodyFont) {
  const body = document.getElementById('tl-body');
  body.style.height = '';
  body.classList.remove('proportional');

  // For horizontal, calculate proportional widths if in proportional mode
  let widthMap = null;
  if (settings.spacingMode === 'proportional' && visibleEntries.length > 1) {
    const sortKeys = visibleEntries.map(e => e.sortKey);
    const minKey = Math.min(...sortKeys);
    const maxKey = Math.max(...sortKeys);
    const span = maxKey - minKey || 1;
    const minGap = settings.minGap || 40;
    const entryWidth = Math.max(140, minGap * 2);
    const totalWidth = Math.max(visibleEntries.length * entryWidth, 800);

    let positions = visibleEntries.map(e => ((e.sortKey - minKey) / span) * (totalWidth - entryWidth));
    for (let i = 1; i < positions.length; i++) {
      if (positions[i] - positions[i-1] < minGap) positions[i] = positions[i-1] + minGap;
    }
    widthMap = visibleEntries.map((e, i) => ({
      marginLeft: i === 0 ? positions[0] : positions[i] - positions[i-1] - entryWidth,
      width: entryWidth
    }));
  }

  let html = '';
  let lastEraInserted = -1;

  visibleEntries.forEach((e, i) => {
    const { color, imp, contentHtml } = buildEntryContentHtml(e, displayFont, bodyFont);
    const isAbove = i % 2 === 0;
    const entryWidth = widthMap ? widthMap[i].width : Math.max(120, settings.entryTitleSize * 8);
    const marginLeft = widthMap ? widthMap[i].marginLeft : settings.spacing + 8;

    // Era divider (vertical label in horizontal mode)
    if (eras.length && settings.showEras) {
      eras.forEach((era, ei) => {
        if (ei > lastEraInserted && e.sortKey >= era.year) {
          html += `<div class="tl-era-divider">
            <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
            <div class="tl-era-label" style="font-family:${displayFont}">${era.label}</div>
            <div class="tl-era-line"></div>
          </div>`;
          lastEraInserted = ei;
        }
      });
    }

    const aboveContent = isAbove ? `<div class="tl-entry-above" style="font-family:${displayFont}">${contentHtml}</div>` : `<div class="tl-entry-above"></div>`;
    const belowContent = isAbove ? `<div class="tl-entry-below"></div>` : `<div class="tl-entry-below" style="font-family:${displayFont}">${contentHtml}</div>`;

    html += `<div class="tl-entry imp-${imp}" style="width:${entryWidth}px;margin-left:${marginLeft}px;flex-shrink:0" data-id="${e.id}">
      ${aboveContent}
      <div class="tl-entry-node">
        <div class="tl-node-dot" style="border-color:${color};background:${color}"></div>
      </div>
      ${belowContent}
    </div>`;
  });

  container.innerHTML = html;
  drawYearGroupBars(visibleEntries, false, true);
}

function getPaperDims(size, orient) {
  const dims = { letter:[816,1056], a4:[794,1123], legal:[816,1344], tabloid:[1056,1632] };
  let [w,h] = dims[size] || dims.letter;
  return orient === 'landscape' ? [h,w] : [w,h];
}

function renderPrintLayout() {
  const container = document.getElementById('print-pages-container');
  const size = document.getElementById('p-size') ? document.getElementById('p-size').value : 'letter';
  const orient = document.getElementById('p-orient') ? document.getElementById('p-orient').value : 'portrait';
  const overlap = parseInt(document.getElementById('p-overlap') ? document.getElementById('p-overlap').value : 30);
  const scale = parseInt(document.getElementById('p-scale') ? document.getElementById('p-scale').value : 75) / 100;
  
  const [pw, ph] = getPaperDims(size, orient);
  const tlCanvas = document.getElementById('timeline-canvas');
  const tlH = tlCanvas.scrollHeight;
  const tlW = tlCanvas.offsetWidth;

  const effectivePageH = ph - overlap;
  const numPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((tlH - overlap) / effectivePageH));

  container.innerHTML = '';
  const displayW = Math.min(780, pw * scale);
  const displayH = ph * (displayW / pw);

  for (let p = 0; p < numPages; p++) {
    const pageDiv = document.createElement('div');
    pageDiv.className = 'print-page';
    pageDiv.style.cssText = `width:${displayW}px;height:${displayH}px;margin:0 auto 6px;overflow:hidden;`;

    // Clone a portion of the timeline
    const inner = document.createElement('div');
    inner.style.cssText = `
      position:absolute;
      width:${tlW}px;
      transform:scale(${displayW/tlW});
      transform-origin:top left;
      top:${-(p * effectivePageH * (displayW/tlW))}px;
      left:0;
    `;
    // We'll use a simplified representation
    inner.innerHTML = `<div style="width:${tlW}px;height:${ph * (tlW/displayW)}px;overflow:hidden;background:${settings.bg};font-family:'Crimson Pro',serif;padding:20px 40px;">
      ${p===0 ? `<div style="font-family:'Playfair Display',serif;font-size:${settings.titleSize*0.6}px;font-weight:900;text-align:center;margin-bottom:10px">${settings.title}</div>` : ''}
      ${entries.slice(Math.floor(p * entries.length / numPages), Math.ceil((p+1) * entries.length / numPages)).map(e => `
        <div style="border-left:3px solid ${e.color};padding:6px 12px;margin-bottom:${Math.max(8,settings.spacing/3)}px;">
          <div style="font-family:'DM Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;opacity:0.5">${e.year}</div>

        </div>
      `).join('')}
    </div>`;
    pageDiv.style.position = 'relative';
    pageDiv.appendChild(inner);

    // Overlap indicator
    if (p < numPages - 1 && overlap > 0) {
      const ov = document.createElement('div');
      ov.className = 'overlap-indicator';
      ov.style.cssText = `bottom:0;height:${overlap * (displayW/pw) * 0.5}px;opacity:0.7`;
      ov.textContent = `↕ ${overlap}px overlap`;
      pageDiv.appendChild(ov);
    }

    // Page number
    const pn = document.createElement('div');
    pn.className = 'print-page-num';
    pn.textContent = `Page ${p+1} of ${numPages}`;
    pageDiv.appendChild(pn);

    container.appendChild(pageDiv);
  }
  document.getElementById('print-info') && (document.getElementById('print-info').textContent = `${numPages} pages · ${overlap}px overlap · ${size.toUpperCase()} ${orient}`);
}

// Helper: wrap text and return array of lines
function wrapText(ctx, text, maxWidth) {
  const words = text.split(' ');
  const lines = [];
  let line = '';
  for (const w of words) {
    const test = line ? line + ' ' + w : w;
    if (ctx.measureText(test).width > maxWidth && line) {
      lines.push(line);
      line = w;
    } else { line = test; }
  }
  if (line) lines.push(line);
  return lines;
}

// Pre-compute entry heights so we know exactly how tall the timeline is
function computeEntryLayout(W, H) {
  // We'll measure approximate height for each entry
  // Title font size matches settings
  const titleFs = Math.max(14, Math.round(settings.entryTitleSize * W / 900));
  const descFs = Math.max(11, Math.round(settings.descSize * W / 900));
  const colW = W * 0.38; // each side column width
  const padding = Math.max(16, settings.spacing + 20);

  // Create offscreen canvas just for measuring
  const mc = document.createElement('canvas');
  mc.width = W; mc.height = 10;
  const mctx = mc.getContext('2d');

  const layout = entries.map((e, i) => {
    let h = titleFs * 2 + 16; // year + title
    if (e.desc) {
      mctx.font = `${descFs}px 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif`;
      const descLines = wrapText(mctx, e.desc, colW - 20);
      h += descLines.length * (descFs * 1.5) + 8;
    }
    if (e.img) h += Math.min(120, W * 0.13) + 12;
    h = Math.max(h, 80) + padding;
    return h;
  });

  // cumulative Y positions
  const headerH = 120; // title block
  const positions = [];
  let y = headerH;
  layout.forEach(h => { positions.push(y + h * 0.15); y += h; });
  const totalH = y + 80;

  return { positions, totalH, titleFs, descFs, colW };
}

function drawVideoFrame(t) {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('video-canvas');
  if (!canvas) return;

  // Only resize if dimensions changed (avoids flicker)
  const res = document.getElementById('v-res').value === '1080' ? [1920,1080] : [1280,720];
  if (canvas.width !== res[0]) canvas.width = res[0];
  if (canvas.height !== res[1]) canvas.height = res[1];
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
  const ink = '#1a1208';
  const parchment = settings.bg || '#f5f0e8';

  // ── BACKGROUND ──
  const noBg = document.getElementById('v-no-bg') && document.getElementById('v-no-bg').checked;
  if (noBg) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  } else {
    ctx.fillStyle = parchment;
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  }

  // Background image
  const bgurl = document.getElementById('v-bgimg').value.trim();
  if (bgurl) {
    if (vidState.bgImgSrc !== bgurl) {
      vidState.bgImg = null;
      vidState.bgImgSrc = bgurl;
      const img = new Image();
      img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
      img.onload = () => { vidState.bgImg = img; };
      img.onerror = () => { vidState.bgImg = null; };
      img.src = bgurl;
    }
    if (vidState.bgImg) {
      const opacity = parseFloat(document.getElementById('v-bg-opacity').value);
      // Draw bg image at full opacity, then overlay the parchment color
      ctx.drawImage(vidState.bgImg, 0, 0, W, H);
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${hexToRgb(parchment)},${opacity})`;
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    }
  }

  // Lined paper texture
  ctx.save();
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(26,18,8,0.04)';
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  for (let ly = 27; ly < H * 4; ly += 28) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, ly); ctx.lineTo(W, ly); ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();

  const dir = document.getElementById('v-dir').value;
  const speed = parseFloat(document.getElementById('v-speed').value);
  const dateFlash = document.getElementById('v-date-flash').checked;
  const doPause = document.getElementById('v-pause').checked;
  const entryAnim = document.getElementById('v-entry-anim').checked;

  if (!entries.length) {
    ctx.fillStyle = ink;
    ctx.font = `italic ${Math.round(W*0.025)}px 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.fillText('No entries yet — add events in the sidebar', W/2, H/2);
    return;
  }

  const { positions, totalH, titleFs, descFs, colW } = computeEntryLayout(W, H);

  // ── SCROLL MATH ──
  // Each entry gets (doPause ? 120 : 80) frames of "pause" + travel frames
  const pauseFrames = doPause ? 90 : 0;
  const travelFrames = Math.round(80 / speed);
  const framesPerEntry = travelFrames + pauseFrames;
  const totalFrames = entries.length * framesPerEntry + travelFrames * 2;
  const rawFrame = (t * 60 * speed) % totalFrames;

  let scrollY;
  if (dir === 'down' || dir === 'zoom') {
    // Map rawFrame → smooth scroll position
    scrollY = (rawFrame / totalFrames) * (totalH + H * 0.2) - H * 0.15;
  }

  let scrollX;
  if (dir === 'left') {
    const totalW = entries.length * W * 0.55 + W * 0.5;
    scrollX = (rawFrame / totalFrames) * (totalW + W) - W * 0.5;
  }

  // ── DRAW MAIN CONTENT (scrolled) ──
  ctx.save();
  if (dir === 'down' || dir === 'zoom') ctx.translate(0, -scrollY);
  else if (dir === 'left') ctx.translate(-scrollX, 0);

  const spineX = dir === 'left' ? W * 0.5 : W / 2;

  // ── SPINE ──
  if (dir !== 'left') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = ink;
    ctx.lineWidth = 2;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(spineX, 60);
    ctx.lineTo(spineX, totalH);
    ctx.stroke();
    // End dots
    ctx.fillStyle = ink;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(spineX, 60, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(spineX, totalH, 5, 0, Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
  }

  // ── TIMELINE TITLE ──
  const titleFsMain = Math.max(24, Math.round(settings.titleSize * W / 900));
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.fillStyle = ink;
  ctx.font = `900 ${titleFsMain}px 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif`;
  ctx.fillText(settings.title, W/2, 70);
  if (settings.subtitle) {
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(26,18,8,0.55)`;
    ctx.font = `italic ${Math.round(titleFsMain*0.42)}px 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif`;
    ctx.fillText(settings.subtitle, W/2, 70 + titleFsMain * 0.55);
  }
  // Red rule under title
  ctx.fillStyle = '#b84c2e';
  ctx.fillRect(W/2 - 30, 80 + titleFsMain * 0.6, 60, 3);

  // ── ENTRIES ──
  entries.forEach((e, i) => {
    const entryScrollPos = dir === 'left'
      ? i * W * 0.55 + W * 0.25
      : positions[i];

    const isLeft = (settings.layout === 'single') ? false : (i % 2 === 0);
    const ex = dir === 'left' ? entryScrollPos : spineX;
    const ey = dir === 'left' ? H / 2 : entryScrollPos;

    // Entry fade-in alpha based on scroll position
    let alpha = 1;
    if (entryAnim && dir !== 'left') {
      const distFromCenter = (ey - scrollY) - H * 0.35;
      alpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 1 - distFromCenter / (H * 0.25)));
      alpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, alpha));
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;

    // Horizontal spine for left-scroll
    if (dir === 'left') {
      ctx.strokeStyle = ink;
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(-W, H/2);
      ctx.lineTo(entries.length * W * 0.55 + W * 2, H/2);
      ctx.stroke();
    }

    // Node dot
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex, ey, Math.round(W * 0.007), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle = parchment;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.round(W * 0.003);
    ctx.stroke();
    // Outer ring
    ctx.strokeStyle = e.color;
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.round(W * 0.002);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ex, ey, Math.round(W * 0.011), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.stroke();

    // Text content
    const textX = dir === 'left'
      ? ex
      : (isLeft ? ex - Math.round(W * 0.03) : ex + Math.round(W * 0.03));
    const textAlign = dir === 'left' ? 'center' : (isLeft ? 'right' : 'left');
    const maxTW = dir === 'left' ? W * 0.4 : colW - 30;
    ctx.textAlign = textAlign;

    // Year
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(26,18,8,0.5)`;
    ctx.font = `${Math.max(10, Math.round(W * 0.011))}px 'DM Mono', monospace`;
    ctx.letterSpacing = '2px';
    const yearY = dir === 'left' ? ey - Math.round(H * 0.1) : ey - Math.round(titleFs * 0.9);
    ctx.fillText(e.year || '', textX, yearY);

    // Entry title
    ctx.fillStyle = e.color;
    ctx.font = `700 ${titleFs}px 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif`;
    const entryTitleY = dir === 'left' ? ey - Math.round(H * 0.05) : ey + Math.round(titleFs * 0.2);
    ctx.fillText(e.title, textX, entryTitleY);

    // Description
    if (e.desc) {
      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(26,18,8,0.72)`;
      ctx.font = `${descFs}px 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif`;
      const lines = wrapText(ctx, e.desc, maxTW);
      const lineH = descFs * 1.5;
      const startY = dir === 'left' ? ey + Math.round(H * 0.04) : entryTitleY + titleFs * 0.5 + 6;
      lines.slice(0, 4).forEach((ln, li) => {
        ctx.fillText(ln, textX, startY + li * lineH);
      });
    }

    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  });

  ctx.restore(); // end scroll transform

  // ── DATE FLASH OVERLAY ──
  if (dateFlash) {
    const currentFrame = (t * 60 * speed) % totalFrames;
    entries.forEach((e, i) => {
      const entryFrame = i * framesPerEntry + travelFrames;
      const delta = currentFrame - entryFrame;
      if (delta > 0 && delta < 60 && e.year) {
        const flashAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - delta / 60);
        // Colored bar at bottom
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(${hexToRgb(e.color)},${flashAlpha * 0.88})`;
        ctx.fillRect(0, H - 130, W, 130);
        // Year text
        ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${flashAlpha})`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'center';
        ctx.font = `900 ${Math.round(W * 0.055)}px 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif`;
        ctx.fillText(e.year, W/2, H - 68);
        // Title text
        ctx.font = `italic ${Math.round(W * 0.019)}px 'Crimson Pro', Georgia, serif`;
        ctx.fillText(e.title, W/2, H - 32);
      }
    });
  }

  // Vignette
  const vig = ctx.createRadialGradient(W/2, H/2, H * 0.28, W/2, H/2, H * 0.78);
  vig.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');
  vig.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0.18)');
  ctx.fillStyle = vig;
  ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
}

function hexToRgb(hex) {
  const r = parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16), g = parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16), b = parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16);
  return `${r},${g},${b}`;
}
function hexToRgbCSS(hex) { return hexToRgb(hex); }
