function startVideoRecording() {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('video-canvas');
  const btn = document.getElementById('record-btn');
  const statusEl = document.getElementById('vid-status');

  if (videoRecorder && videoRecorder.state === 'recording') {
    videoRecorder.stop();
    btn.textContent = '⏺ Record Video';
    return;
  }

  try {
    // Calculate how many total frames we need to record
    // This mirrors the logic in drawVideoFrame so we know exactly when to stop
    const speed = parseFloat(document.getElementById('v-speed').value);
    const doPause = document.getElementById('v-pause').checked;
    const headSec = parseFloat(document.getElementById('v-head').value);
    const tailSec = parseFloat(document.getElementById('v-tail').value);
    const doFade = document.getElementById('v-fade').checked;

    const pauseFrames = doPause ? 90 : 0;
    const travelFrames = Math.round(80 / speed);
    const framesPerEntry = travelFrames + pauseFrames;
    // Total content frames: travel to first entry + all entries + travel past last
    const contentFrames = entries.length * framesPerEntry + travelFrames * 2;
    // Add head and tail at 60fps
    const headFrames = Math.round(headSec * 60);
    const tailFrames = Math.round(tailSec * 60);
    const totalFrames = headFrames + contentFrames + tailFrames;

    const stream = canvas.captureStream(30);
    const chunks = [];
    // Try VP9, fall back to default
    let mimeType = 'video/webm;codecs=vp9';
    if (!MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported(mimeType)) mimeType = 'video/webm';
    videoRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType });
    videoRecorder.ondataavailable = e => { if (e.data.size > 0) chunks.push(e.data); };
    videoRecorder.onstop = () => {
      const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'video/webm' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `${settings.title.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'_')}_timeline_${VERSION}.webm`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      statusEl.textContent = '✓ Saved!';
      btn.textContent = '⏺ Record Video';
    };

    videoRecorder.start(100); // collect data every 100ms
    btn.textContent = '■ Stop Recording';
    statusEl.textContent = `Recording… 0%`;

    let frame = 0;
    const FPS = 60;

    function recordFrame() {
      if (frame > totalFrames || !videoRecorder || videoRecorder.state !== 'recording') {
        vidState.playing = false;
        if (videoRecorder && videoRecorder.state === 'recording') videoRecorder.stop();
        return;
      }

      // Convert frame to "t" that drawVideoFrame understands
      // Head frames play at t=0 (title card), content frames advance t, tail plays last frame
      let tVal;
      if (frame < headFrames) {
        tVal = 0; // hold on title card
      } else if (frame >= headFrames + contentFrames) {
        tVal = (contentFrames / 60) / speed; // hold on last frame
      } else {
        tVal = ((frame - headFrames) / 60) / speed;
      }

      // Draw the frame
      drawVideoFrame(tVal);

      // Apply fade overlay on top
      if (doFade) {
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const W = canvas.width, H = canvas.height;
        const fadeDur = Math.min(30, headFrames, tailFrames > 0 ? tailFrames : 30);
        let fadeAlpha = 0;
        if (frame < fadeDur) {
          fadeAlpha = 1 - (frame / fadeDur);
        } else if (frame > totalFrames - fadeDur) {
          fadeAlpha = (frame - (totalFrames - fadeDur)) / fadeDur;
        }
        if (fadeAlpha > 0) {
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0,0,0,${Math.min(1, fadeAlpha)})`;
          ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
        }
      }

      const pct = Math.round((frame / totalFrames) * 100);
      if (frame % 30 === 0) statusEl.textContent = `Recording… ${pct}%`;

      frame++;
      requestAnimationFrame(recordFrame);
    }
    recordFrame();
  } catch(err) {
    statusEl.textContent = 'Error: ' + err.message;
    alert('Recording failed: ' + err.message + '\n\nTry Chrome or Edge for best results.');
  }
}

function detectMediaType(url) {
  if (!url) return null;
  if (url.includes('youtube.com') || url.includes('youtu.be')) return 'youtube';
  if (url.includes('vimeo.com')) return 'vimeo';
  if (url.match(/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp)(\?|$)/i)) return 'image';
  if (url.match(/\.(mp4|webm|mov)(\?|$)/i)) return 'video';
  return 'link';
}

function getYouTubeEmbedUrl(url) {
  let id = '';
  // youtu.be/ID
  const short = url.match(/youtu\.be\/([^?&]+)/);
  if (short) id = short[1];
  // youtube.com/watch?v=ID
  const watch = url.match(/[?&]v=([^?&]+)/);
  if (watch) id = watch[1];
  // youtube.com/embed/ID
  const embed = url.match(/\/embed\/([^?&]+)/);
  if (embed) id = embed[1];
  if (!id) return null;
  return `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${id}?autoplay=1&controls=0&modestbranding=1&rel=0&showinfo=0`;
}

function getVimeoEmbedUrl(url) {
  const match = url.match(/vimeo\.com\/(\d+)/);
  if (!match) return null;
  return `https://player.vimeo.com/video/${match[1]}?autoplay=1&title=0&byline=0&portrait=0`;
}

function getSheetIdFromUrl(url) {
  if (!url) return null;
  // Standard edit URL: /spreadsheets/d/SHEET_ID/edit
  const editMatch = url.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)/);
  if (editMatch) return { type: 'edit', id: editMatch[1] };
  // Publish URL: /spreadsheets/d/e/PUB_ID/pub
  const pubMatch = url.match(/\/spreadsheets\/d\/e\/([a-zA-Z0-9-_]+)\/pub/);
  if (pubMatch) return { type: 'pub', id: pubMatch[1], rawUrl: url };
  return null;
}

function buildCsvUrl(sheetInfo, tabName) {
  if (!sheetInfo) return null;
  if (sheetInfo.type === 'pub') {
    // Already a publish URL — just make sure output=csv and tab is set
    let base = sheetInfo.rawUrl.split('?')[0];
    let params = `output=csv&single=true`;
    if (tabName) params += `&sheet=${encodeURIComponent(tabName)}`;
    return `${base}?${params}`;
  }
  // Standard sheet ID — use gviz endpoint
  const encodedTab = tabName ? encodeURIComponent(tabName) : '';
  return `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetInfo.id}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv${encodedTab ? '&sheet=' + encodedTab : ''}`;
}

function colLetterToIndex(letter) {
  // Convert column letter (A, B, ... Z, AA) to 0-based index
  letter = (letter || 'A').toUpperCase().trim();
  let n = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < letter.length; i++) {
    n = n * 26 + (letter.charCodeAt(i) - 64);
  }
  return n - 1;
}

function parseCSV(text) {
  // Robust CSV parser handling quoted fields with commas and newlines
  const rows = [];
  let row = [], field = '', inQuote = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i];
    const next = text[i+1];
    if (inQuote) {
      if (ch === '"' && next === '"') { field += '"'; i++; }
      else if (ch === '"') { inQuote = false; }
      else { field += ch; }
    } else {
      if (ch === '"') { inQuote = true; }
      else if (ch === ',') { row.push(field); field = ''; }
      else if (ch === '\n' || (ch === '\r' && next === '\n')) {
        row.push(field); field = '';
        if (row.some(c => c.trim())) rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        if (ch === '\r') i++;
      } else { field += ch; }
    }
  }
  if (field || row.length) { row.push(field); if (row.some(c => c.trim())) rows.push(row); }
  return rows;
}

function fixDriveImageUrl(url) {
  if (!url) return url;
  // Convert Google Drive sharing URL to direct image URL
  // Pattern: drive.google.com/file/d/FILE_ID/view
  const fileMatch = url.match(/\/file\/d\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
  if (fileMatch) return `https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=${fileMatch[1]}`;
  // Already in uc format
  if (url.includes('drive.google.com/uc')) return url;
  return url;
}

function setConnectStatus(state, message) {
  const dot = document.getElementById('connect-status-dot');
  const text = document.getElementById('connect-status-text');
  const colors = { connected: '#4a7c3f', error: '#b84c2e', loading: '#c9923a', disconnected: '#999' };

}

async function connectToSheet() {
  const url = document.getElementById('c-sheet-url').value.trim();
  if (!url) { setConnectStatus('error', 'Paste a sheet URL first'); return; }

  const sheetInfo = getSheetIdFromUrl(url);
  if (!sheetInfo) {

    alert('Could not read a Sheet ID from that URL.\n\nPaste either:\n• Your sheet\'s regular browser URL (ends in /edit)\n• The publish URL from File → Share → Publish to web');
    return;
  }

  connectedSheetUrl = url;
  setConnectStatus('loading', 'Connecting…');

  const tabName = document.getElementById('c-tab-name').value.trim() || '';

  try {

    localStorage.setItem('chronicle_tab_name', tabName);

  } catch(err) {

    if (isFileProtocol) {
      alert('Connection blocked by your browser.\n\nYou\'re opening this file directly from your computer (file://…). Browsers block external requests from local files for security reasons.\n\nFix: Open this file through a local server instead:\n\n• VS Code → install "Live Server" extension → right-click the file → "Open with Live Server"\n\n• Or: Terminal → cd ~/Downloads → python3 -m http.server 8000 → open http://localhost:8000/timeline-builder.html\n\n• Or: Upload to GitHub Pages and open from there.');
    } else {

    }
  }
}

async function loadSheetData(sheetInfo, tabName) {
  // Accept either the new sheetInfo object or a legacy plain string ID
  if (typeof sheetInfo === 'string') {
    sheetInfo = { type: 'edit', id: sheetInfo };
  }
  const csvUrl = buildCsvUrl(sheetInfo, tabName || '');

  // Fetch via CORS proxy isn't needed — Google Sheets CSV is CORS-enabled
  const response = await fetch(csvUrl);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
  const text = await response.text();
  const rows = parseCSV(text);

  if (rows.length < 1) {
    setConnectStatus('error', 'Could not read sheet');
    return;
  }

  // Connected with headers only (no data rows yet) — that's fine
  if (rows.length < 2) {
    setConnectStatus('connected', 'Connected — no entries yet');
    entries = entries.filter(e => e.source === 'manual');
    document.getElementById('c-last-sync').textContent = `Connected · 0 sheet entries · ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString()}`;
    renderAll();
    return;
  }

  // Get column mapping from UI inputs (all default to A-K)
  const getCol = id => colLetterToIndex(document.getElementById(id) ? document.getElementById(id).value : 'A');
  const cm = {
    title:      getCol('cm-title'),
    year:       getCol('cm-year'),
    sort:       getCol('cm-sort'),
    desc:       getCol('cm-desc'),
    color:      getCol('cm-color'),
    img:        getCol('cm-img'),
    media:      getCol('cm-media'),
    category:   getCol('cm-category'),
    importance: getCol('cm-importance'),
    location:   getCol('cm-location'),
    citation:   getCol('cm-citation'),
  };

  // Skip header row (row 0), parse remaining rows in sheet order.
  // Track the last successfully-resolved sort key so that rows lacking both a
  // Sort Key and a parseable Year can inherit a contextually reasonable value
  // (their neighbor's era) instead of defaulting to 0, which would corrupt
  // time-proportional spacing by anchoring the timeline's minimum at year 0.
  const sheetEntries = [];
  let lastResolvedKey = null;
  rows.slice(1).forEach((row, i) => {
    const title = (row[cm.title] || '').trim();
    if (!title) return; // skip empty rows

    const yearVal = (row[cm.year] || '').trim();
    const sortRaw = parseFloat(row[cm.sort]);
    const imgUrl = fixDriveImageUrl((row[cm.img] || '').trim());
    const mediaUrl = (row[cm.media] || '').trim();
    const color = (row[cm.color] || '').trim();

    let sortKey, sortKeyGuessed;
    if (!isNaN(sortRaw)) {
      sortKey = sortRaw;
      sortKeyGuessed = false;
    } else {
      const parsed = parseSortKeyFromYear(yearVal);
      if (parsed !== null) {
        sortKey = parsed;
        sortKeyGuessed = false;
      } else {
        // No usable date info — inherit from the nearest preceding row that had one
        sortKey = lastResolvedKey !== null ? lastResolvedKey : 0;
        sortKeyGuessed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!sortKeyGuessed) lastResolvedKey = sortKey;

    sheetEntries.push({
      id: nextId++,
      title,
      year: yearVal,
      sortKey,
      sortKeyGuessed,
      desc: (row[cm.desc] || '').trim(),
      color: color.startsWith('#') ? color : '#b84c2e',
      category: (row[cm.category] || '').trim(),
      importance: parseInt(row[cm.importance]) || 3,
      location: (row[cm.location] || '').trim(),
      citation: (row[cm.citation] || '').trim(),
      images: imgUrl ? [imgUrl] : [],
      img: imgUrl || null,
      imageDisplay: 'inline',
      mediaUrl: mediaUrl || null,
      addedOrder: i,
      source: 'sheet'
    });
  });

  // Second pass: any entries at the very TOP of the sheet that had no preceding
  // resolved key (lastResolvedKey was still null when they were processed) should
  // inherit forward from the first entry that DID resolve, rather than sitting at 0.
  const firstResolved = sheetEntries.find(e => !e.sortKeyGuessed);
  if (firstResolved) {
    for (const e of sheetEntries) {
      if (e.sortKeyGuessed && e.sortKey === 0 && sheetEntries.indexOf(e) < sheetEntries.indexOf(firstResolved)) {
        e.sortKey = firstResolved.sortKey;
      } else break;
    }
  }

  // Replace sheet-sourced entries, keep manual ones
  const manualEntries = entries.filter(e => e.source === 'manual');
  entries = [...sheetEntries, ...manualEntries];
  entries.forEach((e, i) => e.addedOrder = i);

  const now = new Date();
  document.getElementById('c-last-sync').textContent =
    `Last synced: ${now.toLocaleTimeString()}  ·  ${sheetEntries.length} entries loaded`;

  renderAll();
}

function guessSortKeyFromYear(yearStr) {
  // Standalone version for use outside the form context
  if (!yearStr) return 0;
  const s = yearStr.replace(/,/g,'').trim();
  const bce = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*(bce|bc)/i);
  if (bce) return -Math.abs(parseFloat(bce[1]));
  const bya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*bya/i);
  if (bya) return -parseFloat(bya[1]) * 1e9;
  const mya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*mya/i);
  if (mya) return -parseFloat(mya[1]) * 1e6;
  const kya = s.match(/(-?\d+\.?\d*)\s*kya/i);
  if (kya) return -parseFloat(kya[1]) * 1e3;
  const plain = s.match(/^-?\d+\.?\d*/);
  return plain ? parseFloat(plain[0]) : 0;
}

  if (oobeStep === 1) {

    if (!name) { document.getElementById('oobe-name').focus(); return; }

    // Apply the chosen theme immediately
    const chosenTheme = document.querySelector('input[name="oobe-theme"]:checked').value;

    // Set the timeline title

    document.getElementById('s-title').value = name;

    if (author) localStorage.setItem('chronicle_default_author', author);

    if (entries.length > 0) {
      const confirmed = confirm(`Start a new timeline "${name}"?\n\nThis will clear your current ${entries.length} entries. Save your work first if needed.`);
      if (!confirmed) return;
    }
    entries = [];
    nextId = 1;

    renderAll();

    if (useSheets) {
      oobeStep = 2;
      oobeShowStep(2);
    } else {
      // Skip sheets entirely — just launch
      closeModal('new-timeline-modal');
      switchTab('add');
    }

  } else if (oobeStep === 2) {
    // Just advance — they've downloaded the script and set up the sheet
    oobeStep = 3;
    oobeShowStep(3);

  } else if (oobeStep === 3) {
    // Connect to the sheet and launch
    const url = document.getElementById('oobe-sheet-url').value.trim();
    const tabName = document.getElementById('oobe-tab-name').value.trim();

    if (!url) {
      document.getElementById('oobe-connect-status').textContent = '⚠ Paste your sheet URL first, or go back and uncheck Google Sheets.';
      return;
    }

    const sheetInfo = getSheetIdFromUrl(url);
    if (!sheetInfo) {
      document.getElementById('oobe-connect-status').textContent = '⚠ That doesn\'t look like a valid Google Sheet URL.';
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('oobe-connect-status').textContent = 'Connecting…';

    document.getElementById('c-sheet-url').value = url;
    document.getElementById('c-tab-name').value = tabName || settings.title;

    loadSheetData(sheetInfo, tabName || null)
      .then(() => {
        setConnectStatus('connected', 'Connected');
        localStorage.setItem('chronicle_sheet_url', url);
        localStorage.setItem('chronicle_tab_name', tabName);

        document.getElementById('c-mapping-section').style.display = '';
        document.getElementById('c-refresh-section').style.display = '';
        document.getElementById('c-links-section').style.display = '';
        document.getElementById('c-sheet-link').href = url;

        switchTab('entries');
      })
      .catch(err => {
        document.getElementById('oobe-connect-status').textContent =
          '⚠ Could not load sheet. Make sure you published it as CSV first.\n' + err.message;
      });
  }
}

  const name = prompt('Name this preset:', settings.title + ' style');
  if (!name) return;
  const preset = { ...getPresetData(), name };
  userPresets.push(preset);
  try { localStorage.setItem('chronicle_presets', JSON.stringify(userPresets)); } catch(e) {}
  renderPresetsList();

  // Also offer file download
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(preset, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.download = name.replace(/[^a-z0-9]/gi,'_').toLowerCase() + `_preset_${VERSION}.json`;
  a.href = url; a.click();
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

function loadPresetFile() {
  const input = document.createElement('input');
  input.type = 'file';
  input.accept = '.json';
  input.onchange = e => {
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = ev => {
      try {
        const preset = JSON.parse(ev.target.result);
        applyPreset(preset);
        // Also add to saved list if not already there
        if (!userPresets.find(p => p.name === preset.name)) {
          userPresets.push(preset);
          try { localStorage.setItem('chronicle_presets', JSON.stringify(userPresets)); } catch(e) {}
          renderPresetsList();
        }
      } catch(err) { alert('Invalid preset file'); }
    };
    reader.readAsText(file);
  };
  input.click();
}

function applyPreset(preset) {
  const keys = ['bg','bgimg','bgOpacity','overrideColors','overrideColor','overrideFonts','fontDisplay','fontBody','spineColor','titleSize','entryTitleSize','descSize','spacing','layout'];
  keys.forEach(k => { if (preset[k] !== undefined) settings[k] = preset[k]; });
  const sv = (id, val) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && val !== undefined) el.value = val; };
  const sc = (id, val) => { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && val !== undefined) el.checked = val; };
  sv('s-bg', settings.bg);
  sv('s-bgimg', settings.bgimg || '');
  sv('s-bg-opacity', settings.bgOpacity);
  sv('s-title-size', settings.titleSize);
  sv('s-entry-title-size', settings.entryTitleSize);
  sv('s-desc-size', settings.descSize);
  sv('s-spacing', settings.spacing);
  sv('s-layout', settings.layout);
  sv('s-override-color', settings.overrideColor);
  sv('s-spine-color', settings.spineColor);
  sv('s-font-display', settings.fontDisplay);
  sv('s-font-body', settings.fontBody);
  sc('s-override-colors', settings.overrideColors);
  sc('s-override-fonts', settings.overrideFonts);
  document.querySelectorAll('.range-val').forEach(el => {
    const inp = el.previousElementSibling;
    if (inp && inp.type === 'range') {
      const v = inp.value;
      el.textContent = v + (inp.id === 's-zoom' ? '%' : inp.id.includes('opacity') ? '%' : 'px');
    }
  });
  renderAll();
}

function guessViewerHostingUrl() {
  // If the builder itself is hosted on the web (e.g. GitHub Pages), guess where a
  // sibling timeline-viewer.html would live — same directory as the current page.
  // Returns null if running from a local file, since no real URL can be guessed there.
  if (window.location.protocol === 'file:') return null;
  const path = window.location.pathname;
  const lastSlash = path.lastIndexOf('/');
  const lastSegment = path.slice(lastSlash + 1);
  // If the last segment looks like a filename (has a dot, e.g. index.html), treat
  // everything before it as the directory. Otherwise the whole path is a directory.
  const dir = lastSegment.includes('.') ? path.slice(0, lastSlash + 1) : (path.endsWith('/') ? path : path + '/');
  return window.location.origin + dir + 'timeline-viewer.html';
}

function copyIframeCode() {

    setTimeout(() => btn.textContent = 'Copy iframe code', 2000);
  }).catch(() => {
    // Fallback

    ta.value = code;
    document.body.appendChild(ta);
    ta.select();
    document.execCommand('copy');
    document.body.removeChild(ta);
  });

<script>
// ── CONFIG (baked in at export time) ──
const SHEET_ID = '${sheetId}';
const PUB_BASE = '${(sheetInfo && sheetInfo.type === 'pub') ? sheetInfo.rawUrl.split('?')[0] : ''}';
const IS_PUB_URL = ${(sheetInfo && sheetInfo.type === 'pub') ? 'true' : 'false'};
const TAB_NAME = '${tabName.replace(/'/g,"\\'")}';
const REFRESH_MS = ${refreshInterval};
const IMP_COLORS = ${JSON.stringify(s.importanceColors || {1:'#999999',2:'#7a9e7a',3:'#b84c2e',4:'#c9923a',5:'#7c3aed'})};
const CAT_COLORS = ${JSON.stringify(s.categoryColors || {})};
const SETTINGS = ${JSON.stringify({
  titleSize: s.titleSize,
  entryTitleSize: s.entryTitleSize,
  descSize: s.descSize,
  spacing: s.spacing,
  layout: s.layout,
  orientation: s.orientation || 'vertical',
  mobileOrientation: s.mobileOrientation || 'vertical',
  spacingMode: s.spacingMode || 'equal',
  minGap: s.minGap || 40,
  compactMode: s.compactMode || false,
  spineColor: s.spineColor,
  overrideColors: s.overrideColors,
  overrideColor: s.overrideColor,
  displayFont: displayFont,
  bodyFont: bodyFont,
  eras: s.eras || '',
  showEras: s.showEras !== false,
  bg: s.bg
})};

// ── STATE ──
let allEntries = [];
let activeCategories = new Set();
let minImp = 1;
let lbImages = [], lbIdx = 0, lbTitle = '';
let popupHideTimer = null;

// ── CSV FETCH ──
function buildCsvUrl() {
  if (IS_PUB_URL && PUB_BASE) {
    let params = 'output=csv&single=true';
    if (TAB_NAME) params += '&sheet=' + encodeURIComponent(TAB_NAME);
    return PUB_BASE + '?' + params;
  }
  // Standard sheet ID via gviz
  return \`https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/\${SHEET_ID}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv\${TAB_NAME ? '&sheet=' + encodeURIComponent(TAB_NAME) : ''}\`;
}

function parseCSV(text) {
  const rows = []; let row = [], field = '', inQ = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const ch = text[i], nx = text[i+1];
    if (inQ) { if (ch==='"'&&nx==='"'){field+='"';i++;} else if(ch==='"'){inQ=false;} else{field+=ch;} }
    else { if(ch==='"'){inQ=true;} else if(ch===','){row.push(field);field='';} else if(ch==='\\n'||(ch==='\\r'&&nx==='\\n')){row.push(field);field='';if(row.some(c=>c.trim()))rows.push(row);row=[];if(ch==='\\r')i++;} else{field+=ch;} }
  }
  if(field||row.length){row.push(field);if(row.some(c=>c.trim()))rows.push(row);}
  return rows;
}

function colIdx(letter) {
  letter = (letter||'A').toUpperCase().trim(); let n=0;
  for(let i=0;i<letter.length;i++) n=n*26+(letter.charCodeAt(i)-64);
  return n-1;
}

function fixDriveUrl(url) {
  if(!url) return url;
  const m = url.match(/\\/file\\/d\\/([a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)/);
  if(m) return \`https://drive.google.com/uc?export=view&id=\${m[1]}\`;
  return url;
}

function guessSortKey(yr) {
  if(!yr) return 0;
  const s = yr.replace(/,/g,'').trim();
  const bce = s.match(/(-?\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*(bce|bc)/i); if(bce) return -Math.abs(parseFloat(bce[1]));
  const bya = s.match(/(-?\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*bya/i); if(bya) return -parseFloat(bya[1])*1e9;
  const mya = s.match(/(-?\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*mya/i); if(mya) return -parseFloat(mya[1])*1e6;
  const kya = s.match(/(-?\\d+\\.?\\d*)\\s*kya/i); if(kya) return -parseFloat(kya[1])*1e3;
  const p = s.match(/^-?\\d+\\.?\\d*/); return p ? parseFloat(p[0]) : 0;
}

async function loadData() {
  if(!SHEET_ID) { document.getElementById('loading-state').textContent = 'No sheet connected.'; return; }
  document.getElementById('viewer-sync-status').textContent = '⟳ Syncing…';
  try {
    const res = await fetch(buildCsvUrl());
    if(!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    const text = await res.text();
    const rows = parseCSV(text);
    if(rows.length < 2) { document.getElementById('loading-state').textContent = 'Sheet is empty.'; return; }
    // Column mapping A=0,B=1,C=2,D=3,E=4,F=5,G=6
    allEntries = rows.slice(1).map((row,i) => {
      const title = (row[0]||'').trim(); if(!title) return null;
      const yr = (row[1]||'').trim();
      const sortRaw = parseFloat(row[2]);
      const color = (row[4]||'').trim();
      return {
        id: i,
        title,
        year: yr,
        sortKey: isNaN(sortRaw) ? guessSortKey(yr) : sortRaw,
        desc: (row[3]||'').trim(),
        color: color.startsWith('#') ? color : (IMP_COLORS[3]||'#b84c2e'),
        images: fixDriveUrl((row[5]||'').trim()) ? [fixDriveUrl((row[5]||'').trim())] : [],
        mediaUrl: (row[6]||'').trim(),
        category: (row[7]||'').trim(),
        importance: parseInt(row[8])||3,
        location: (row[9]||'').trim(),
        citation: (row[10]||'').trim(),
        imageDisplay: 'inline'
      };
    }).filter(Boolean);

    renderTimeline();
    rebuildFilters();
    const now = new Date();
    const ts = document.getElementById('viewer-timestamp');
    if(ts) ts.textContent = 'Last updated: ' + now.toLocaleTimeString();
    document.getElementById('viewer-sync-status').textContent = '✓ Live';
    setTimeout(()=>{ document.getElementById('viewer-sync-status').textContent=''; }, 3000);
  } catch(err) {
    document.getElementById('viewer-sync-status').textContent = '⚠ Sync error';
    console.error('Chronicle viewer error:', err);
  }
}

// ── RENDER ──
function getVisible() {
  return allEntries.filter(e => {
    const catOk = activeCategories.size === 0 || activeCategories.has(e.category||'');
    const impOk = (e.importance||3) >= minImp;
    return catOk && impOk;
  });
}

function parseEras() {
  if(!SETTINGS.eras||!SETTINGS.showEras) return [];
  return SETTINGS.eras.split('\\n').map(line => {
    const parts = line.split(','); if(parts.length<2) return null;
    const yr = parseFloat(parts[0].trim()), label = parts.slice(1).join(',').trim();
    return (!isNaN(yr)&&label) ? {year:yr,label} : null;
  }).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>a.year-b.year);
}

function renderTimeline() {
  const container = document.getElementById('tl-entries-container');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('timeline-canvas');
  const body = document.getElementById('tl-body') || canvas.querySelector('.tl-body');
  const visible = getVisible();
  const dFont = SETTINGS.displayFont||"'Playfair Display',Georgia,serif";
  const bFont = SETTINGS.bodyFont||"'Crimson Pro',Georgia,serif";
  const isMobile = window.innerWidth <= 768;
  const orientation = isMobile ? SETTINGS.mobileOrientation : SETTINGS.orientation;

  // Apply classes
  canvas.classList.toggle('horizontal', orientation === 'horizontal');
  canvas.classList.toggle('single-col', SETTINGS.layout === 'single' && orientation === 'vertical');
  canvas.classList.toggle('compact', SETTINGS.compactMode);
  canvas.classList.toggle('mobile-vertical', isMobile && SETTINGS.mobileOrientation === 'vertical' && SETTINGS.orientation === 'horizontal');

  // Dark theme
  const bgHex = SETTINGS.bg || '#f5f0e8';
  const r=parseInt(bgHex.slice(1,3),16),g=parseInt(bgHex.slice(3,5),16),b=parseInt(bgHex.slice(5,7),16);
  canvas.classList.toggle('theme-dark', (r*299+g*587+b*114)/1000 < 128);

  if(!visible.length) {
    container.innerHTML = '<div id="loading-state">No entries match the current filters.</div>';
    return;
  }

  // Proportional spacing
  let posMap = null, widthMap = null;
  const minGap = SETTINGS.minGap || 40;
  if (SETTINGS.spacingMode === 'proportional' && visible.length > 1) {
    const keys = visible.map(e=>e.sortKey);
    const minK = Math.min(...keys), maxK = Math.max(...keys), span = maxK-minK||1;
    if (orientation === 'vertical') {
      const totalSize = Math.max(600, visible.length*minGap*2);
      let pos = visible.map(e=>((e.sortKey-minK)/span)*totalSize);
      for(let i=1;i<pos.length;i++) if(pos[i]-pos[i-1]<minGap) pos[i]=pos[i-1]+minGap;
      const hdr=120, tot=pos[pos.length-1]+120;
      posMap={};
      visible.forEach((e,i)=>{posMap[e.id]={pos:pos[i]+hdr,total:tot};});
      if(body){body.style.height=tot+'px';body.classList.add('proportional');}
    } else {
      const ew=Math.max(140,minGap*2), tw=Math.max(visible.length*ew,800);
      let pos=visible.map(e=>((e.sortKey-minK)/span)*(tw-ew));
      for(let i=1;i<pos.length;i++) if(pos[i]-pos[i-1]<minGap) pos[i]=pos[i-1]+minGap;
      widthMap=visible.map((e,i)=>({ml:i===0?pos[0]:pos[i]-pos[i-1]-ew,w:ew}));
      if(body){body.style.height='';body.classList.remove('proportional');}
    }
  } else {
    if(body){body.style.height='';body.classList.remove('proportional');}
  }

  const eras = parseEras();
  let html='', lastEra=-1;

  // Year grouping for connector thickness
  const grpMap = new Map();
  visible.forEach(e => {
    const k = Math.round(e.sortKey);
    if (!grpMap.has(k)) grpMap.set(k, []);
    grpMap.get(k).push(e.id);
  });
  const grpSize = new Map(), grpIdx = new Map();
  grpMap.forEach(ids => ids.forEach((id,i) => { grpSize.set(id,ids.length); grpIdx.set(id,i); }));
  function vThick(n) { return Math.min(6.5, 1.5 + (n-1)*1.2); }

  function makeVConn(e, color, isLeft) {
    const cnt = grpSize.get(e.id)||1, thick = vThick(cnt);
    const side = isLeft ? \`right:calc(50% - 38px)\` : \`left:calc(50% - 38px)\`;
    const hbr = isLeft ? '1px 0 0 1px' : '0 1px 1px 0';
    return \`<div style="position:absolute;\${side};top:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;pointer-events:none;z-index:1"><div style="height:\${thick*0.55}px;width:22px;background:\${color};opacity:0.38;border-radius:\${hbr}"></div></div>\`;
  }

  visible.forEach((e,i)=>{
    const color = SETTINGS.overrideColors ? SETTINGS.overrideColor
      : (CAT_COLORS[e.category]||e.color||'#b84c2e');
    const imp=e.importance||3;
    const impScale=[0,0.8,0.9,1,1.12,1.28][imp]||1;
    const titleSize=Math.round(SETTINGS.entryTitleSize*impScale);
    const impLabels=['','BLIP','MOMENT','EVENT','MILESTONE','LANDMARK'];
    const safeMedia=(e.mediaUrl||'').replace(/'/g,"\\'");
    const mType=detectMediaType(e.mediaUrl);
    const mediaBadge=mType?\`<div class="media-badge" style="color:\${color}" onmouseenter="showMediaPopup(event,'\${safeMedia}','\${mType}')" onmouseleave="scheduleHidePopup()" onclick="showMediaPopup(event,'\${safeMedia}','\${mType}')">\${mType==='youtube'||mType==='vimeo'||mType==='video'?'▶':'⊞'}</div>\`:'';
    const imgs=e.images&&e.images.length?e.images:[];
    let imgsHtml='';
    if(imgs.length){
      if(e.imageDisplay==='thumbnail') imgsHtml=\`<div class="tl-img-gallery">\${imgs.map((src,idx)=>\`<img class="tl-img-thumb" src="\${src}" onclick="openLightbox(\${e.id},\${idx})" />\`).join('')}</div>\`;
      else imgsHtml=\`<img class="tl-img-inline" src="\${imgs[0]}" onclick="openLightbox(\${e.id},0)" />\`;
    }
    const isJunk = v => { if(!v) return true; const s=String(v).trim().toLowerCase(); return s==='true'||s==='false'||s==='null'||s==='undefined'||s==='nan'; };
    const contentInner=\`
      \${imp!==3?\`<div class="imp-badge" style="color:\${color}">\${impLabels[imp]}</div>\`:''}
      <div class="tl-entry-year">\${e.year}</div>
      <div class="tl-entry-title" style="font-size:\${titleSize}px;color:\${color};font-family:\${dFont}">\${e.title}</div>
      \${!isJunk(e.location)?\`<div style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:\${SETTINGS.descSize-3}px;opacity:0.4;margin-top:3px">📍 \${e.location}</div>\`:''}
      \${e.desc?\`<div class="tl-entry-desc">\${e.desc}</div>\`:''}
      \${!isJunk(e.citation)?\`<div class="tl-entry-citation">Source: \${e.citation}</div>\`:''}
      \${imgsHtml}\${mediaBadge}\`;

    // Era dividers
    if(eras.length) eras.forEach((era,ei)=>{
      if(ei>lastEra&&e.sortKey>=era.year){
        if(orientation==='horizontal') html+=\`<div class="tl-era-divider"><div class="tl-era-line"></div><div class="tl-era-label" style="font-family:\${dFont}">\${era.label}</div><div class="tl-era-line"></div></div>\`;
        else html+=\`<div class="tl-era-divider" style="position:\${posMap?'absolute;top:'+(posMap[e.id].pos-30)+'px;left:0;right:0':'relative'};z-index:1"><div class="tl-era-line"></div><div class="tl-era-label" style="font-family:\${dFont}">\${era.label}</div><div class="tl-era-line"></div></div>\`;
        lastEra=ei;
      }
    });

    if(orientation==='horizontal'){
      const isAbove=i%2===0;
      const ew=widthMap?widthMap[i].w:Math.max(120,SETTINGS.entryTitleSize*8);
      const ml=widthMap?widthMap[i].ml:SETTINGS.spacing+8;
      html+=\`<div class="tl-entry imp-\${imp}" style="width:\${ew}px;margin-left:\${ml}px;flex-shrink:0" data-id="\${e.id}">
        \${isAbove?\`<div class="tl-entry-above" style="font-family:\${dFont}">\${contentInner}</div><div class="tl-entry-node"><div class="tl-node-dot" style="width:14px;height:14px;border-color:\${color};background:\${color}"></div></div><div class="tl-entry-below"></div>\`
        :\`<div class="tl-entry-above"></div><div class="tl-entry-node"><div class="tl-node-dot" style="width:14px;height:14px;border-color:\${color};background:\${color}"></div></div><div class="tl-entry-below" style="font-family:\${dFont}">\${contentInner}</div>\`}
      </div>\`;
    } else {
      const posStyle=posMap?\`position:absolute;top:\${posMap[e.id].pos}px;width:100%\`:\`padding-bottom:\${SETTINGS.spacing+20}px\`;
      const isLeft = SETTINGS.layout !== 'single' && i % 2 === 0;
      const conn = orientation !== 'horizontal' ? makeVConn(e, color, isLeft) : '';
      html+=\`<div class="tl-entry imp-\${imp}" style="\${posStyle};position:relative" data-id="\${e.id}">
        \${SETTINGS.layout!=='single'?'<div class="tl-entry-spacer"></div>':''}
        <div class="tl-entry-node"><div class="tl-node-dot" style="width:14px;height:14px;border-color:\${color};background:\${color}"></div></div>
        <div class="tl-entry-content" style="background:\${SETTINGS.bg||'#f5f0e8'}">\${contentInner}</div>
        \${conn}
      </div>\`;
    }
  });

  container.innerHTML=html;
  drawYearGroupBars(visible, SETTINGS.layout==='single', orientation==='horizontal');
}

function drawYearGroupBars(visibleList, isSingle, isHorizontal) {
  const body = document.getElementById('tl-body') || document.querySelector('.tl-body');
  if (!body) return;
  body.querySelectorAll('.year-group-bar').forEach(el => el.remove());

  const groups = new Map();
  visibleList.forEach(e => {
    const k = Math.round(e.sortKey);
    if (!groups.has(k)) groups.set(k, []);
    groups.get(k).push(e);
  });

  const bodyRect = body.getBoundingClientRect();

  groups.forEach(members => {
    if (members.length < 2) return;
    const thick = vThick(members.length);
    const color = members[0].color || '#1a1208';
    let minPos = Infinity, maxPos = -Infinity;

    members.forEach(e => {
      const nodeEl = body.querySelector(\`.tl-entry[data-id="\${e.id}"] .tl-node-dot\`);
      if (!nodeEl) return;
      const r = nodeEl.getBoundingClientRect();
      const center = isHorizontal
        ? (r.left - bodyRect.left + r.width / 2)
        : (r.top - bodyRect.top + r.height / 2);
      minPos = Math.min(minPos, center);
      maxPos = Math.max(maxPos, center);
    });
    if (minPos === Infinity || maxPos - minPos < 1) return;

    const bar = document.createElement('div');
    bar.className = 'year-group-bar';
    if (isHorizontal) {
      bar.style.cssText = \`position:absolute;left:\${minPos}px;width:\${maxPos-minPos}px;height:\${thick}px;top:calc(50% - \${thick/2}px);background:\${color};opacity:0.4;border-radius:\${thick/2}px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none\`;
    } else {
      const leftPos = isSingle ? '40px' : '50%';
      const transform = isSingle ? '' : 'transform:translateX(-50%)';
      bar.style.cssText = \`position:absolute;top:\${minPos}px;height:\${maxPos-minPos}px;width:\${thick}px;left:\${leftPos};\${transform};background:\${color};opacity:0.4;border-radius:\${thick/2}px;z-index:1;pointer-events:none\`;
    }
    body.appendChild(bar);
  });
}

// ── FILTERS ──
const palette = ['#b84c2e','#0a6fa8','#4a7c3f','#c9923a','#7c3aed','#0891b2'];
function rebuildFilters() {
  const cats = [...new Set(allEntries.map(e=>e.category||'').filter(Boolean))];
  const el = document.getElementById('filter-chips');
  const sep = document.getElementById('filter-sep-1');
  if(!el) return;
  if(!cats.length) { el.innerHTML=''; if(sep)sep.style.display='none'; return; }
  if(sep)sep.style.display='';
  cats.forEach((cat,i) => { if(!CAT_COLORS[cat]) CAT_COLORS[cat]=palette[i%palette.length]; });

function detectMediaType(url) {
  if(!url) return null;
  if(url.includes('youtube.com')||url.includes('youtu.be')) return 'youtube';
  if(url.includes('vimeo.com')) return 'vimeo';
  if(url.match(/\\.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|webp)(\\?|$)/i)) return 'image';
  if(url.match(/\\.(mp4|webm|mov)(\\?|$)/i)) return 'video';
  return 'link';
}
function getYTEmbed(url) {
  const short=url.match(/youtu\\.be\\/([^?&]+)/),watch=url.match(/[?&]v=([^?&]+)/),emb=url.match(/\\/embed\\/([^?&]+)/);
  const id=(short&&short[1])||(watch&&watch[1])||(emb&&emb[1]); if(!id)return null;
  return \`https://www.youtube.com/embed/\${id}?autoplay=1&controls=0&modestbranding=1&rel=0&showinfo=0\`;
}
function getVimeoEmbed(url) { const m=url.match(/vimeo\\.com\\/(\\d+)/); return m?\`https://player.vimeo.com/video/\${m[1]}?autoplay=1&title=0&byline=0\`:null; }
function showMediaPopup(event,url,type) {
  clearTimeout(popupHideTimer);
  const popup=document.getElementById('media-popup'), content=document.getElementById('media-popup-content'), label=document.getElementById('media-popup-label-text');
  popup.classList.remove('visible');
  let html='';
  if(type==='youtube'){const eu=getYTEmbed(url);label.textContent='▶ YouTube';html=eu?\`<iframe src="\${eu}" allow="autoplay;encrypted-media" allowfullscreen></iframe>\`:'<p style="color:white;padding:20px">Could not parse URL</p>';}
  else if(type==='vimeo'){const eu=getVimeoEmbed(url);label.textContent='▶ Vimeo';html=eu?\`<iframe src="\${eu}" allow="autoplay" allowfullscreen></iframe>\`:'<p style="color:white;padding:20px">Could not parse URL</p>';}
  else if(type==='image'){label.textContent='⊞ Image';html=\`<img src="\${url}" alt="Media" />\`;}
  else if(type==='video'){label.textContent='▶ Video';html=\`<video src="\${url}" controls autoplay style="width:100%;max-height:200px;background:#000"></video>\`;}
  else{label.textContent='🔗 Link';html=\`<div style="padding:16px;color:rgba(245,240,232,0.7);font-family:monospace;font-size:10px;word-break:break-all">\${url}<br><br><a href="\${url}" target="_blank" style="color:#c9923a">Open ↗</a></div>\`;}
  content.innerHTML=html;
  const rect=event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
  let left=rect.right+10, top=rect.top-40;
  if(left+320>window.innerWidth-20)left=rect.left-330;
  if(top+220>window.innerHeight-20)top=window.innerHeight-230;
  if(top<10)top=10;
  popup.style.left=left+'px'; popup.style.top=top+'px';
  popup.classList.add('visible');
  popup.onmouseenter=()=>clearTimeout(popupHideTimer);
  popup.onmouseleave=()=>scheduleHidePopup();
}
